ko: <expr=Neutral>그래! 야수가 날아가던 중 비늘 덮인 꼬리에서 이 금속 깃털이 떨어졌지.

en: <expr=disgust>And then an unsuspecting ranger found it...
<expr=scary>CAUSE IT IMPALED THEM RIGHT THROUGH THE HEART!
<expr=Neutral>Take this to your old lady in the woods, I'm sure she'll be happy.
<expr=disgust>And if you ever bring me scrap again, you better bring at least 15 lilies with it if you want anything good done with it
ko: <expr=disgust>앞으로 또 고철을 가져올 거라면, 제대로 손봐 달라는 대가로 백합을 최소 15송이는 챙겨 와.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>I brought another thingamajig! I got it from Tony in Sawdust.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>또 신기한 걸 가져왔어요! 소더스트의 토니한테 받았어요.

en: <expr=Neutral>Bring this back to me along with 15 of the dark lilies and I'll see what I can do.
ko: <expr=Neutral>검은 백합 15송이와 함께 다시 가져와. 뭘 할 수 있을지 보지.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Yes ma'am. This weird gift from Tony.
<expr=Neutral>Ah yes, the industrious beaver. Always so hard-working.
<expr=confused>Never had someone to share the fruits of his labor with.
<expr=sad>Strange creatures, fathers. Wildly different from one family to another.
<expr=Neutral>You can always spot a good one from a mile away.
<expr=Neutral>Just by the look in their eye when watching their hatchlings.
<expr=confused>I suppose the same goes for the bad ones, but they're not usually preoccupied with keeping an eye on their kin.
ko: <expr=confused>나쁜 아버지도 마찬가지겠지만, 그런 이들은 보통 자식을 지켜보는 데 관심이 없지.

en: <expr=disgust>Of course you've never met yours, have you?
<expr=surprised>What? Be the local bog witch and not know these things? I'd be ushered away in a second.
ko: <expr=surprised>뭐? 동네 늪 마녀가 그런 것도 몰라서야 되겠어? 당장 쫓겨날걸.

en: <expr=sad>The symbol of a father's love, something some folks search for their entire lives.
ko: <expr=sad>아버지의 사랑을 상징하지. 어떤 이들은 평생 찾아 헤매는 것.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>Yes! I found a broken mirror, from the strange animal in the Winterberry refuge.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>네! 윈터베리 대피소의 이상한 동물에게 깨진 거울을 받았어요.

en: <expr=Neutral>Bring this back to me along with 15 of the dark lilies and I'll see what I can do.
ko: <expr=Neutral>검은 백합 15송이와 함께 다시 가져와. 뭘 할 수 있을지 보지.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Yep, right here, the broken mirror from Cian.
<expr=disgust>A sad tale there. Engineered by cruelty, as many are.
ko: <expr=disgust>슬픈 사연이지. 여느 때처럼 잔혹함이 만들어 낸 이야기야.

en: <expr=sad>Cian was never the same creature after he found himself in the Valley.
ko: <expr=sad>키안은 계곡에 온 뒤로 예전의 자신으로 돌아가지 못했어.

en: <expr=confused>I suspect that seeing yourself in such moments.
<expr=cry>Is to be constantly reminded of all you've lost.
<expr=confused>They say it's bad luck to break a mirror. Seven years of misfortune.
<expr=annoyed>Pfft, no one questions their sources anymore.
<expr=surprised>And what of the poor bastards who've already been served their slice of crap?
ko: <expr=surprised>이미 인생이 꼬일 대로 꼬인 가엾은 놈들은 어쩌고?

en: <expr=confused>They couldn't care less, as long as it doesn't mean they don't have to look their disappointments in the face.
ko: <expr=confused>자기 실망스러운 꼴을 마주하지 않아도 된다면 그런 건 신경도 안 쓸 텐데.

en: <expr=sad>It will show the viewer nothing but themselves with an honesty that not everyone is ready for.
ko: <expr=sad>들여다보는 이의 모습만 보여 주지. 모두가 감당할 수 있는 건 아닐 만큼 솔직하게 말이야.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Yeah! Twiggy gave me this old magnet from the swamp!
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>네! 트위기가 늪에서 찾은 낡은 자석을 줬어요!

en: <expr=Neutral>Bring this back to me along with 15 of the dark lilies and I'll make it presentable.
ko: <expr=Neutral>검은 백합 15송이와 함께 다시 가져와. 보기 좋게 해 주지.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Yep, right here, the magnet from Twiggy.
<expr=Neutral>If you want to baffle even the most educated scholar, just ask them how a magnet works.
ko: <expr=Neutral>아무리 배운 학자라도 당황하게 만들려면 자석이 어떻게 작동하는지 물어봐.

en: <expr=annoyed>They'll no doubt explain what it does, but not why.
ko: <expr=annoyed>무슨 일을 하는지는 설명해도 왜 그러는지는 말 못 할걸.

en: <expr=disgust>They can't, and what have we learned about things without explanation?
ko: <expr=disgust>설명을 못 하지. 설명할 수 없는 것에 관해 뭘 배웠더라?

en: <expr=Neutral>This might be the only thing in your collection of mystery that's actually a little mysterious.
ko: <expr=Neutral>네 수수께끼 수집품 중 정말 조금이라도 신비로운 건 이것뿐일지도 모르겠군.

en: <expr=Neutral>It will keep doing its job long after we've all gotten sick of ours.
ko: <expr=Neutral>우리 모두 제 일에 질려 버리고 한참이 지나도 계속 제 몫을 하겠지.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>I don't have the capacity to be fast.
<expr=disgust>Except when bringing me garbage to turn into gold, you mean.
ko: <expr=disgust>쓰레기를 금으로 바꿔 달라고 가져올 때만 빼고 말이지.

en: <expr=confused>Then you're as quick as a wink.
<expr=disgust>I'm sure you've had a fair bit of success with your displays.
<expr=confused>Or else you wouldn't keep showing up.
ko: <expr=confused>안 그러면 이렇게 계속 찾아올 리가 없잖아.

en: <expr=Neutral>So my price has, let's say, adjusted to the market.
ko: <expr=Neutral>그러니 내 가격도, 말하자면 시세에 맞춰 조정됐어.

en: <expr=blush>For all the hard work I've done.
<expr=surprised>I'll need 100 lilies upfront and from now on it'll be 30 lilies per artefact!
<expr=Neutral>I'll throw in a little extra something for your trouble.
<expr=confused>It's a shame that you're taking all of these magnificent artefacts I've been making for you.
ko: <expr=confused>내가 만들어 준 멋진 유물들을 전부 가져다가.

en: <expr=disgust>And showing them off on tiny wooden stands like a cheap garage sale.
ko: <expr=disgust>싸구려 벼룩시장처럼 작은 나무 받침대에 늘어놓는 건 안타까운 일이야.

en: <expr=Neutral>Take this. It should make everything pop, as they say.
ko: <expr=Neutral>이걸 받아. 사람들이 말하듯 확 살아날 거야.

en: <expr=Neutral>Come back when you've got enough lilies for me.
<expr=Neutral>Oh good, another priceless article I'm sure.
<expr=Neutral>Well, I suppose a grifter's efforts are as good as any for our purposes.
ko: <expr=Neutral>뭐, 우리 목적이라면 사기꾼의 성과도 다른 물건 못지않게 쓸 만하지.

en: <expr=Neutral>Bring it back along with 30 lilies and I'll make it presentable.
ko: <expr=Neutral>백합 30송이와 함께 다시 가져와. 보기 좋게 해 줄게.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Yep, I got this busted suitcase from Took! It's got something inside worth millions!
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>네, 툭에게 망가진 여행 가방을 받았어요! 안에 수백만짜리 물건이 있대요!

en: <expr=disgust>Let me guess, no one can get it open.
<expr=blush>It could be anything, and that's worth more than the box itself.
ko: <expr=blush>뭐든 들어 있을 수 있다는 점이 상자 자체보다 가치가 있거든.

en: <expr=Neutral>What could be in there? Someone's old clothes? Maybe.
ko: <expr=Neutral>안에 뭐가 있을까? 누군가의 낡은 옷? 그럴지도.

en: <expr=scary>Someone's darkest secrets that they just so happened to take along on their unpaid vacation and then left behind?
ko: <expr=scary>무급휴가에 우연히 챙겨 갔다가 두고 온, 누군가의 가장 어두운 비밀?

en: <expr=Neutral>Thus making this unclaimed baggage a most fascinating display.
ko: <expr=Neutral>그러니 이 주인 없는 짐은 아주 흥미로운 전시품이 되는 거야.

en: <expr=Neutral>Alright, what've you got for me now?
<stance=Neutral><expr=mad>I've got uhh... some strands of silk? Claire found them in the garbage dump near the highway.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>어... 비단 가닥이요? 클레어가 도로 근처 쓰레기장에서 찾았대요.

en: <expr=confused>I've polished some crap you've brought before, but this sounds excessive, even for you.
ko: <expr=confused>네가 가져온 허접한 걸 다듬어 준 적은 있지만, 이건 너치고도 좀 심하군.

en: <expr=disgust>Get me 30 lilies as usual and bring these... things back as well.
ko: <expr=disgust>늘 하던 대로 백합 30송이와 이... 물건들을 다시 가져와.

en: <expr=surprised>What the... Where did you say you got these again?
<expr=disgust>Nevermind. I uhh... I don't need to know.
<expr=confused>I think it's safe to say you've found one of the only genuinely rare items so far.
ko: <expr=confused>지금까지 찾은 물건 중 진짜 희귀한 몇 안 되는 물건이라고 해도 되겠군.

en: <expr=disgust>I can't go into details with you, but let's just say these strands used to be someone's home.
ko: <expr=disgust>자세히 말해 줄 순 없지만, 이 가닥들은 누군가의 집이었다고 해 두지.

en: <expr=sad>Someone you wouldn't want to have a midnight encounter with.
<expr=Neutral>At least that's what you're going to write on the plaque when you display this strange, giant cocoon.
ko: <expr=Neutral>적어도 이 이상하고 거대한 고치를 전시할 때 안내판에는 그렇게 쓰라고.

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=bored>I've got some discounted dog collars from Anni.
<expr=confused>Uhh, okay? Bring me 30 lilies and the collars, then we can talk.
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Not a great haul this time around. I only found these discounted dog collars from Anni.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>이번 수확은 별로예요. 애니한테서 할인 개 목줄만 구했어요.

en: <expr=annoyed>Hmm, yes. Well, it could've been worse.
ko: <expr=annoyed>음, 그래. 뭐, 더 나쁠 수도 있었겠지.

en: <expr=confused>Alright fine, fortunately you don't have to go far in catching the short attention span of your average Human.
ko: <expr=confused>좋아, 됐어. 다행히 평범한 인간의 짧은 관심을 사로잡는 데는 그리 거창한 게 필요 없어.

en: <expr=disgust>It seems like there aren't enough horrors in the world already, so Humans decided to make some up.
ko: <expr=disgust>세상에 공포가 이미 충분하지 않았는지, 인간들은 직접 만들어 내기로 했지.

en: <expr=confused>These myths and stories, are they real or just fairy tales?
<expr=disgust>There's nothing more fascinating than what our own minds dream up.
ko: <expr=disgust>자기 머릿속에서 그려 낸 것만큼 흥미로운 것도 없지.

en: <expr=blush>And even if you think something is just imaginary, doesn't a sliver of doubt make it that more interesting?
ko: <expr=blush>상상 속 이야기라 생각해도 약간의 의심이 더 흥미롭게 만들지 않겠어?

en: <expr=Neutral>Behold a dog collar fit for a mythical beast. Who's to say they didn't need the occasional walk?
ko: <expr=Neutral>신화 속 짐승에게 걸맞은 목줄을 보아라. 가끔 산책할 필요가 없었다고 누가 장담하겠어?

en: <expr=Neutral>What've you got for me this time?
<stance=HandsDown><expr=scared>Oh yeah, just a photo from Sabine.
<expr=Neutral>Get me 30 lilies and I'll turn it into a masterpiece.
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Yeah! It's a blurry photo of a weird creature that's definitely not Human! Sabine snapped it in the forest!
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>네! 인간이 절대 아닌 이상한 생물을 찍은 흐릿한 사진이에요! 사빈이 숲에서 찍었대요!

en: <expr=Neutral>Yeah, weird fella old Greg. He used to roam the forest long before people were people.
ko: <expr=Neutral>그래, 이상한 늙은 그레그. 인간이 인간이 되기도 전부터 숲을 돌아다녔지.

en: <expr=confused>I guess he was out for his anual stroll. You just don't get any privacy these days.
ko: <expr=confused>연례 산책을 나왔었나 보군. 요즘은 사생활도 없다니까.

en: <expr=disgust>I'm sure Sabine was over the moon with her, erm... discovery.
ko: <expr=disgust>사빈은 그 어... 발견에 뛸 듯이 기뻤겠지.

en: <expr=Neutral>Which is why this will be a hit with the rest of your crowd.
<expr=Neutral>I'm certain this wasn't Greg's first impromptu photoshoot.
ko: <expr=Neutral>그레그의 즉석 촬영이 처음은 아니었을 게 분명해.

en: <expr=blush>He does like the attention. Don't we all?
<stance=HandsUp><expr=happy>I would rather stay buried underground all year round.
ko: <stance=HandsUp><expr=happy>전 일 년 내내 땅속에 파묻혀 있고 싶은데요.

en: <expr=confused>Yes, well, some of us have egos to tend to.
ko: <expr=confused>그래, 뭐, 우리 중엔 자존심도 챙겨야 하는 이들이 있으니까.

en: <expr=Neutral>I've spruced up the photo and gave it a sophisticated sounding name.
ko: <expr=Neutral>사진을 좀 다듬고 고상하게 들리는 이름을 붙였어.

en: <expr=Neutral>It should raise even the most skeptical eyebrow.
<expr=sad>Everything is cold here, even the cold.
<expr=confused>You can't have peace and quiet on the outside if it's noisy on the inside.
ko: <expr=confused>속이 시끄러운데 바깥에서 평온과 고요를 찾을 수는 없지.

en: <expr=cry>I never thought the thing I'd miss most would be a thick, quiet branch to nap on.
ko: <expr=cry>가장 그리운 게 낮잠 잘 굵고 조용한 나뭇가지일 줄은 몰랐어.

en: <expr=Neutral>If you come across any honey, I wouldn't mind a small bite.
<expr=confused>I've been holding on to something I found here. My only possession.
ko: <expr=confused>여기서 찾은 물건 하나를 간직해 왔지. 내 유일한 소유물이야.

en: <expr=angry>This mirror was the only unbroken thing in this horrid place.
ko: <expr=angry>이 거울은 이 끔찍한 곳에서 유일하게 깨지지 않은 물건이었어.

en: <expr=scared>It stayed that way for several weeks.
<expr=sad>Until I could bear to look at it no more.
<expr=cry>Or rather, see what it tried to show me.
ko: <expr=cry>아니, 거울이 보여 주려는 걸 견디지 못할 때까지.

en: <expr=grumpy>I know it's not worth anything, but I would much prefer you took it away.
ko: <expr=grumpy>아무 가치 없다는 건 알지만, 네가 가져가면 좋겠군.

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>That's alright. I've got plenty of energy!
<stance=Hunched><expr=scary>Oh. Can I get you something to get you back up on your feet?
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=scary>아. 다시 일어설 힘이 나게 뭘 가져다드릴까요?

en: <expr=Neutral>But it feels like ages since I've tasted the sweet nectar of bees.
ko: <expr=Neutral>하지만 벌이 만드는 달콤한 꿀을 맛본 지 아주 오래된 기분이군.

en: <stance=HandsUp><expr=happy>I can definitely get you some of that!
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>I know your name is Cian. Are you ok?
<expr=scary>DO NOT SPEAK... do not speak that name.
<stance=HandsDown><expr=blush>Oh, sorry. I heard it from someone else.
<expr=sad>No one dares speak that name, for it is as dead as its bearer.
ko: <expr=sad>아무도 감히 그 이름을 입에 올리지 않는다. 그 주인만큼이나 죽은 이름이니.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>You don't look dead to me... I think.
<expr=Neutral>No. Indeed. The frost likes to play around with you that way. Never sharp enough to deal a lethal blow.
ko: <expr=Neutral>아니. 그렇지. 서리는 그런 식으로 농락하기를 좋아해. 치명타를 날릴 만큼 날카롭지는 않지.

en: <expr=scared>But rather keep you on the edge of becoming a palid corpse.
ko: <expr=scared>그저 창백한 시체가 되기 직전에 머물게 할 뿐.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Can I help? I could make some fire?
<expr=scary>DO NOT ASSUME... do not assume you know what I've suffered through.
ko: <expr=scary>짐작하지 마라... 내가 겪은 고통을 안다고 짐작하지 마.

en: <expr=grumpy>And that you can simply fix it.
<expr=angry>Like you've fixed the lodges for those demons to return.
<stance=Hunched><expr=scary>Oh... I see. What do you do here?
<expr=scary>NOTHING! I do nothing! Nothing but sit and freeze. That is what I do.
ko: <expr=scary>아무것도! 아무것도 안 해! 앉아서 얼어붙기만 하지. 그게 내 일이야.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>Can I get you something warm to eat maybe?
<expr=surprised>You fool. There's nothing in this world that could ever begin to warm these old insides.
ko: <expr=surprised>어리석군. 이 세상 그 무엇도 이 늙은 속을 조금도 데울 수 없어.

en: <expr=angry>It is nothing but a shallow attempt at sympathy.
<expr=angry>Go away. There's nothing you can bring that would warm me.
ko: <expr=angry>가라. 뭘 가져와도 날 데우지 못할 테니.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>I brought you something! I thought you'd need more than usual so I made more than usual!
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>뭐 좀 가져왔어요! 평소보다 많이 드셔야 할 것 같아서 더 만들었죠!

en: <expr=angry>I told you, your efforts are quite futile.
<expr=confused>You've done quite the impossible feat. You've given me a memory.
ko: <expr=confused>불가능한 일을 해냈군. 잊었던 기억을 떠올리게 해 줬어.

en: <expr=Neutral>A memory I thought was long forgotten.
<stance=Hunched><expr=sad>I didn't know... Can I help you? Do you want to get out of here?
<expr=scared>There was nothing in the world I would've wanted more a few years ago.
ko: <expr=scared>몇 년 전이라면 그보다 원하는 건 없었겠지.

en: <expr=sad>Now... I have nothing to return to. Time has passed over me and over the world.
ko: <expr=sad>이제는... 돌아갈 곳이 없어. 세월이 나도, 세상도 바꿔 놓았으니.

en: <expr=confused>The creature that came here is gone and so is its home.
ko: <expr=confused>여기 왔던 옛날의 나는 사라졌고, 고향도 사라졌어.

en: <expr=cry>And I live here, in this rundown, cold ruin.
<expr=angry>I will continue this debate no longer. I leave you with something in return for your soup.
ko: <expr=angry>더는 이 논쟁을 계속하지 않겠다. 수프의 답례로 한 가지 남겨 주지.

en: <expr=scared>There are dark forces you do not understand that govern this world.
ko: <expr=scared>네가 이해하지 못하는 어둠의 힘들이 이 세상을 다스린다.

en: <expr=confused>They sometimes torment my dreams and bother my sleep.
<expr=surprised>The answers you seek are behind doors, locked by these forces.
ko: <expr=surprised>네가 찾는 답은 그 힘들이 잠가 놓은 문 뒤에 있어.

en: <expr=confused>You must find three horned devils by the sea.
<expr=Neutral>They will lead you where you wish to go.
<expr=confused>Leave me be. Do I look like three horned devils to you?
ko: <expr=confused>내버려 둬. 내가 뿔 달린 악마 셋으로 보이나?

en: <expr=mad>What the boss says, goes. No exception.
<expr=coy>He's been digging through scraps longer than you've known how to wear a hat.
ko: <expr=coy>네가 모자 쓰는 법을 알기 전부터 고물을 뒤져 온 분이야.

en: <expr=Neutral>You can't rush the dig, the garbage heap can smell fear.
ko: <expr=Neutral>발굴은 서두르면 안 돼. 쓰레기 더미는 두려움의 냄새를 맡거든.

en: <expr=surprised>One bad step and BLAMO! Buried for life.
ko: <expr=surprised>한 발만 잘못 디뎌도 쾅! 평생 묻히는 거야.

en: <expr=annoyed>Everyone acts tough until the cockroach starts flying.
<expr=annoyed>I need at least three prospector's tools. Where are they?
ko: <expr=annoyed>채굴 장비가 적어도 세 개는 필요해. 어디 있어?

en: <expr=mad>Alright, I'm not gonna repeat myself. Listen carefully.
ko: <expr=mad>좋아, 두 번 말 안 해. 잘 들어.

en: <expr=Neutral>It was a particularly dark and heavy night. I had been digging all day, no dice.
ko: <expr=Neutral>유난히 어둡고 무거운 밤이었어. 하루 종일 팠지만 허탕이었지.

en: <expr=surprised>When I suddenly heard a scream from deep inside the dump. I rushed towards the sound.
ko: <expr=surprised>그런데 쓰레기장 깊은 곳에서 갑자기 비명이 들렸어. 소리가 나는 쪽으로 달려갔지.

en: <expr=mad>In the middle of an overturned pile of junk I saw it. A weird cocoon-like thing, busted open.
ko: <expr=mad>뒤집힌 고물 더미 한가운데에서 봤어. 깨져 열린 이상한 고치 같은 걸.

en: <expr=surprised>Whatever was inside had been wrapped in these weird strands of silk that had slime all over.
ko: <expr=surprised>안에 뭐가 있었든, 끈적한 점액이 묻은 이상한 비단 가닥에 싸여 있었어.

en: <expr=mad>I grabbed a couple and ran back as fast as I could. I never found it again after that night, no matter where I looked.
ko: <expr=mad>몇 가닥 집어 들고 최대한 빨리 도망쳤지. 그날 밤 이후로 아무리 찾아도 다시는 못 봤어.

en: <expr=annoyed>Anyway, these have been sitting in my closet since, getting eaten by moths.
ko: <expr=annoyed>어쨌든 그 뒤로 옷장 안에서 좀벌레 밥이나 되고 있었지.

en: <expr=sad>Take 'em, they still freak me out a little.
<expr=coy>Why are you here? Out looking for a job again?
<stance=Neutral><expr=coy>Actually, things are going pretty well with the cabins and Humans and all.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>사실 산장이랑 인간 손님들 일은 잘돼 가고 있어요.

en: <expr=Neutral>Oh... Well, good! At least someone knows the value of an honest day's work around here.
ko: <expr=Neutral>아... 그럼 다행이네! 이 동네에 정직하게 일하는 가치를 아는 녀석이 하나는 있어서.

en: <expr=mad>Unlike Wade! That lazy rat, always running away.
ko: <expr=mad>웨이드랑은 다르군! 맨날 도망이나 치는 게으른 쥐 같으니.

en: <stance=HandsUp><expr=happy>I'm looking for super secret artefacts that Humans would like!
ko: <stance=HandsUp><expr=happy>인간들이 좋아할 초특급 비밀 유물을 찾고 있어요!

en: <expr=coy>Oh you are huh? Only the best know how to find 'em.
ko: <expr=coy>그래? 최고만이 그런 걸 찾는 법을 알지.

en: <expr=mad>And I find a lot of them.
<expr=happy>I'm running low on digging supplies. Get me some and I'll let you have something I found recently.
ko: <expr=happy>발굴 물자가 모자라. 좀 구해 주면 최근에 찾은 걸 하나 주지.

en: <expr=Neutral>Smarter beings than you knew better than to come here.
ko: <expr=Neutral>너보다 현명한 존재들은 여길 찾아올 생각도 하지 않았다.

en: <expr=Neutral>People and Animals aren't all that different.
<expr=bored>I have no obligation to make sense to you.
ko: <expr=bored>네가 이해할 수 있도록 말할 의무는 없다.

en: What do you know about People?
<expr=annoyed>Humans are a walking, talking plague upon the world.
<expr=Neutral>They are capable of creating means they do not comprehend.
ko: <expr=Neutral>스스로 이해하지도 못하는 수단을 만들어 낼 수 있지.

en: <expr=annoyed>Means of creation and means of destruction.
<expr=Neutral>They do not value other life around them, unless it is to their benefit.
ko: <expr=Neutral>자신에게 이익이 되지 않으면 주변의 다른 생명을 존중하지 않는다.

en: <expr=annoyed>Their stupidity brought immeasurable destruction to this land.
ko: <expr=annoyed>그 어리석음이 이 땅에 헤아릴 수 없는 파괴를 불러왔다.

en: <expr=Neutral>Bringing suffering to themselves, but also all the animals.
What about us? What do you know about Animals?
<stance=Neutral><expr=blush>What about us? What do you know about Animals?
<expr=Neutral>Animals are nothing if not less destructive Humans.
<expr=laughing>Animals do not seek to live beyond their means.
ko: <expr=laughing>동물은 제 분수를 넘어 살려 하지 않는다.

en: <expr=Neutral>Survival is both a noble and self-sustainable goal that Animals do not seek to overstep.
ko: <expr=Neutral>생존은 고귀하면서도 그 자체로 완결된 목표다. 동물은 그 이상을 탐하지 않지.

en: <expr=laughing>They are more sincere and less volatile than Humans.
<expr=Neutral>That is why the God aspects keep their animal form.
<stance=HandsDown><expr=surprised>So Gods are real? Are you a God?
Alright um... What do you know about Gods?
ko: 좋아, 음... 신에 대해서는 뭘 알아?

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>Alright um... What do you know about Gods?
<expr=bored>Gods are simple to perceive but difficult to understand.
<expr=Neutral>We are aspects of the world, concentrated into a conscious form.
ko: <expr=Neutral>우리는 세상의 측면들이 의식을 지닌 형태로 응축된 존재다.

en: <expr=laughing>We are not born, we are an accumulation of energies emitted by the universe.
ko: <expr=laughing>태어나는 것이 아니라 우주가 내뿜는 에너지가 쌓여 만들어지지.

en: <expr=Neutral>Every world is different and every universe radiates different energies that assemble different Gods.
ko: <expr=Neutral>세계마다 다르고, 우주마다 다른 에너지를 내보내 서로 다른 신을 이룬다.

en: <expr=angry>I am one of them. In this universe, I am the God of disorder and fear.
ko: <expr=angry>나도 그중 하나다. 이 우주에서 나는 무질서와 두려움의 신이지.

en: <expr=annoyed>Think very carefully about your next question, it could very well be your last.
ko: <expr=annoyed>다음 질문은 신중히 골라라. 마지막 질문이 될 수도 있으니.

en: Oh... umm... I guess... which one of the Gods looks like a bird?
ko: 아... 음... 그러니까... 신 중에 새처럼 생긴 신도 있어?

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>Oh... umm... I guess... which one of the Gods looks like a bird?
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>아... 음... 그러니까... 신 중에 새처럼 생긴 신도 있어?

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=bored>Yeah... That's the only one I saw in my dream.
<expr=Neutral>You saw Kai in your dreams? That is not possible.
<stance=Hunched><expr=confused>So it's Kai then? What are they the God of?
<stance=Neutral><expr=angry>Come on! I've asked like twenty questions already! Just give me a straight answer!
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=angry>아, 좀! 벌써 질문을 스무 개는 했잖아! 그냥 똑바로 대답해 줘!

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>I'll tell you if you tell me what's going on!
<expr=Neutral>A disruption occurred in recent times. I do not know what it involved, but I know that it was strong.
ko: <expr=Neutral>얼마 전 큰 혼란이 있었다. 어떤 일이었는지는 모르나 강력했다는 것은 안다.

en: <expr=annoyed>Humans enacted an amount of pain and destruction of overwhelming proportions.
<expr=Neutral>I have been here, trying to prevent another occurrence.
<stance=HandsDown><expr=scared>I saw a dark figure with what looked like wings and very bright blue eyes.
ko: <stance=HandsDown><expr=scared>날개 같은 게 달린 검은 형체를 봤어. 눈은 아주 밝은 파란색이었고.

en: <expr=cry>How could you see Kai? You have been making great efforts to entice Humans back into this Valley.
ko: <expr=cry>네가 어떻게 카이를 봤지? 넌 인간들을 이 계곡으로 다시 끌어들이려고 애써 왔다.

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=disgust>It's like you said, not all People are bad. Some are actually really nice, but some... yeah, some can really suck.
ko: <stance=HandsDown><expr=disgust>네 말대로 인간이 다 나쁜 건 아니야. 정말 좋은 사람도 있지만... 그래, 정말 못된 사람도 있지.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>A lot of them just like to leave trash everywhere though.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>그런데 쓰레기를 아무 데나 버리는 사람이 많긴 해.

en: <expr=Neutral>Before the disruption, Kai reached out to me. They left me a relic.
ko: <expr=Neutral>혼란이 일어나기 전 카이가 나를 찾아왔다. 유물을 하나 남겼지.

en: <expr=bored>An onyx stone. A relic darker than the night.
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Oh, that's like the little needle I used to get in this place.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>아, 여기 들어올 때 쓴 작은 바늘하고 비슷하네.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>Oh geez, alright! The doorway had a picture of a stag, and one of its little antler bits was missing.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>세상에, 알았어! 문에 수사슴 그림이 있었는데 뿔가지 하나가 빠져 있었어.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>It looked just like that, very dark but shiny. When I put it in, the door opened.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>그거랑 똑같았어. 아주 검지만 반짝였지. 끼워 넣었더니 문이 열렸어.

en: <expr=bored>I see. Then it is clear what I must do.
<expr=Neutral>You will take the onyx stone and you will use it to find Kai.
<stance=Neutral><expr=blush>What? How am I supposed to do that?
<expr=bored>That is as far as my knowledge reaches. You must reach that conclusion on your own.
ko: <expr=bored>내가 아는 것은 거기까지다. 답은 네가 스스로 찾아야 한다.

en: <expr=angry>But you must do it. And it must be soon.
<stance=Hunched><expr=scary>I was just getting used to this place.
<expr=bored>You take on a great risk for coming here.
ko: <expr=bored>여기 오는 것만으로도 큰 위험을 무릅쓰고 있다.

en: <expr=Neutral>I'm surprised you found your way in.
<expr=angry>You are to speak only when spoken to.
<expr=annoyed>This is not your parrot friend's cellar.
<expr=Neutral>I am Eris and I do not respond to any inquiries.
<expr=bored>You are just as guilty as them for opening the way again.
ko: <expr=bored>다시 길을 열어 준 네 죄도 그들과 같다.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>Opening the way? For who? The People?
<expr=angry>If you wish to ask a question, I will grant you one answer.
<expr=happy>Is this thing broken? Hello? Can anyone here me?
<expr=excited>Mic check, one two, one two, watcha gonna, watcha gonna do when.
ko: <expr=excited>마이크 테스트, 하나 둘, 하나 둘. 자, 이제 어쩔 건데, 어쩔 건데.

en: <expr=mad>No ma', I'm at work. Yes ma' I got the package you sent me.
ko: <expr=mad>아니, 엄마. 일하는 중이야. 응, 보내 준 택배 받았어.

en: <expr=confused>No ma', when am I gonna eat that many sausages?
ko: <expr=confused>아니, 엄마. 그 많은 소시지를 언제 다 먹어?

en: <expr=happy>Listen ma' I got to go, I'm workin. Yes ma', I love you too.
ko: <expr=happy>엄마, 끊어야 해. 일하고 있거든. 응, 나도 사랑해.

en: <expr=Neutral>Nothing to lose? Nothing to gain! Grab opportunity by the THROAT and show it who's boss!
ko: <expr=Neutral>잃을 게 없다고요? 얻을 것도 없죠! 기회의 목덜미를 움켜쥐고 누가 주인인지 보여 주세요!

en: <expr=happy>Congratulations! You have been automatically entered into a standard legally binding agreement...
ko: <expr=happy>축하합니다! 법적 구속력이 있는 표준 계약이 자동 체결되었습니다...

en: <expr=disgust>By using your fingerprint identification data from the local Police Department.
ko: <expr=disgust>지역 경찰서에 등록된 고객님의 지문 식별 정보를 이용했습니다.

en: <expr=excited>Welcome to the family, ERROR UNKNOWN PATTERN!
ko: <expr=excited>가족이 되신 걸 환영합니다, 오류 알 수 없는 패턴 님!

en: <expr=Neutral>You are now contractually obligated to provide your Premium Property details within the next 3 business days!
ko: <expr=Neutral>이제 계약에 따라 영업일 기준 3일 이내에 프리미엄 부동산 정보를 제출하셔야 합니다!

en: <expr=Neutral>Simply press the green button under my gullet when the Premises are ready to accept our first guest!
ko: <expr=Neutral>첫 손님을 받을 준비가 되면 제 목 아래 초록색 버튼을 눌러 주세요!

en: <expr=excited>Alright! Who knows anything about Human houses?
<stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>Well, I used to look at the pictures of the houses in the magazines we found.
<expr=confused>Could the Humans maybe just live under a bus?
ko: <expr=confused>인간들도 그냥 버스 밑에서 살면 안 될까?

en: <expr=Neutral>No, I don't think that cuts it. They're fragile and get scared easily.
ko: <expr=Neutral>아니, 그건 안 될걸. 연약하고 겁도 많거든.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>I think I know a thing or two about making a place cozy!
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>집을 포근하게 만드는 법은 나도 좀 알아!

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=angry>And I do NOT get scared that easily!
<expr=grumpy>Yeah, but I think we need help too. We should go find Tony.
ko: <expr=grumpy>그래도 도움이 필요할 것 같아. 토니를 찾아가자.

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=surprised>I really don't think we should bother him.
<expr=happy>He won't mind! Besides, I think he'll enjoy the company.
<stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>I don't even know where he is these days.
<expr=Neutral>I doubt he ever left Sawdust. Go see if you can sniff him out and tell him we need his master woodwork skills.
ko: <expr=Neutral>소더스트를 떠났을 리 없어. 냄새를 맡아서 찾아보고 목공 장인의 솜씨가 필요하다고 해.

en: <expr=Neutral>Nothing to lose? Nothing to gain! Grab opportunity by the THROAT, and show it who's boss!
ko: <expr=Neutral>잃을 게 없다고요? 얻을 것도 없죠! 기회의 목덜미를 움켜쥐고 누가 주인인지 보여 주세요!

en: <expr=Neutral>Be part of the next Exciting Experience, Enticing Escape, ELECTRIFYING ENTERPRISE!
ko: <expr=Neutral>흥미진진한 경험, 매혹적인 탈출, 짜릿한 사업의 다음 주인공이 되세요!

en: <expr=happy>YOU there, fine... gentleman, in the, uh, orange coat!
ko: <expr=happy>거기, 훌륭한... 신사분. 어, 주황색 외투를 입으신 분!

en: <expr=mad>How would YOU like to own the next minor share in the next MAJOR MANEUVER?
ko: <expr=mad>차세대 대형 사업의 작은 지분을 소유해 보시면 어떻겠습니까?

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>Well, I'm not into anything major, but I do like sharing.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>큰 건 별로지만 나눠 갖는 건 좋아해.

en: <expr=disgust>And, I must reiterate, the share is VERY minor.
<stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>What do we get to share again?
<expr=happy>PAWN VOYAGE is a multinational, multi-layered, multi-your-friend CORPORATION...
ko: <expr=happy>폰 보야지는 다국적, 다층적, 다 너를 위한 기업입니다...

en: <expr=Neutral>Offering Secured Touristry Adjacent Goods and Services in exchange for Valuable Personal Collateral.
ko: <expr=Neutral>귀중한 개인 담보를 받고 안전한 관광 인접 상품 및 서비스를 제공합니다.

en: <expr=bored>Don't think he ever had me to begin with.
<expr=Neutral>Just bring in your old, useless, priceless family jewelry OR expensive heirloom of choice and we'll give YOU...
ko: <expr=Neutral>낡고 쓸모없지만 값을 매길 수 없는 가보 보석이나 비싼 유산을 가져오시면...

en: <expr=happy>A 1-3 day all-inclusive voucher for the VACATION OF A LIFETIME!
<stance=Neutral><expr=coy>Sorry, buddy, I don't have anything expensive, or a hair loom.
<expr=happy>Pawn VOYAGE is also on the lookout for BRAND NEW VENTURES and LOCATIONS...
ko: <expr=happy>폰 보야지는 새로운 사업과 장소도 찾고 있습니다...

en: <expr=Neutral>Making a microscopic dent into the wealth you'll need to accumulate over your considerable lifetime!
ko: <expr=Neutral>평생 필요한 만큼의 재산을 모으는 데 아주아주 조금 진전하셨군요!

en: <expr=Neutral>Different locations can support different, exclusive amenities.
ko: <expr=Neutral>장소마다 서로 다른 독점 편의 시설을 지원할 수 있습니다.

en: <expr=disgust>Due to the rising costs of the industry, our guests will have expectations for such luxury comforts.
ko: <expr=disgust>업계 비용이 오르니 손님들은 이런 호화로운 편의를 기대합니다.

en: <expr=cry>And definitely not because of brazenly inflated advertising we are now legally obligated to disclose.
ko: <expr=cry>이제 법적으로 고지해야 하는 뻔뻔한 과장 광고 때문은 절대 아닙니다.

en: <expr=Neutral>Remember, if you're looking to expand your little enterprise and our real estate empire.
ko: <expr=Neutral>여러분의 작은 사업과 당사의 부동산 제국을 넓히고 싶다면 기억하세요.

en: <expr=happy>Be on the lookout for the Pectoral Fin of Profit.
<expr=happy>This month only, get a 2% coupon for our sister company FLIGHT OR FREIGHT!
ko: <expr=happy>이번 달 한정! 자매 회사 플라이트 오어 프레이트 2% 할인 쿠폰을 드립니다!

en: <expr=Neutral>For all your package delivery and shipping needs.
<expr=Neutral>The only question we ask is "cash or card"!
<expr=Neutral>Here at Pawn Voyage, we take steps every day to recognize and appreciate.
ko: <expr=Neutral>저희 폰 보야지는 매일 인정과 감사의 뜻을 전하려 노력합니다.

en: <expr=Neutral>Our most valuable associates for their commitment and contributions.
<expr=disgust>You currently do not meet the criteria for recognition.
<expr=Neutral>In fact, our metrics suggest your performance falls under our "detestation" level.
ko: <expr=Neutral>실제로 당사 지표에 따르면 고객님의 성과는 "혐오" 단계입니다.

en: <expr=Neutral>However, your recent development into outdoors leisure for this property.
ko: <expr=Neutral>하지만 최근 해당 시설에 야외 여가 활동을 개발하신 덕분에.

en: <expr=Neutral>You are now one step closer towards achieving something in your life.
ko: <expr=Neutral>이제 인생에서 무언가를 이루는 데 한 걸음 더 다가섰습니다.

en: <expr=Neutral>There are many, many, many steps left.
ko: <expr=Neutral>아직 아주, 아주, 아주 많은 단계가 남아 있습니다.

en: <expr=Neutral>The next one, in fact, is meeting our criteria for a property in this location.
ko: <expr=Neutral>바로 다음 단계는 이 지역 시설의 기준을 맞추는 것입니다.

en: <expr=Neutral>Which you should observe in order to be further entrusted with our guests' experience.
ko: <expr=Neutral>당사가 손님들의 경험을 계속 맡겨 드릴 수 있도록 준수해 주세요.

en: <expr=Neutral>Why watch the world through a screen when you can trade it in for the real thing?
ko: <expr=Neutral>화면을 진짜 세상으로 바꿀 수 있는데 왜 화면으로만 보시나요?

en: <expr=happy>Now accepting trade-ins for high definition electronics at any Pawn Location!
ko: <expr=happy>이제 모든 폰 지점에서 고화질 전자제품도 보상 판매로 받습니다!

en: <expr=Neutral>None more impressive than the one against nature itself!
<expr=Neutral>A solid roof over our heads and a dry floor to sleep on have become the preferred way of life for many!
ko: <expr=Neutral>튼튼한 지붕 아래 마른 바닥에서 자는 건 많은 이들이 선호하는 삶이 됐습니다!

en: <expr=happy>The opportunity to profit from taking all of it away!
ko: <expr=happy>그 모든 걸 빼앗고 돈을 벌 기회죠!

en: <expr=Neutral>This area supports the development of outdoor facilities.
ko: <expr=Neutral>이 지역에는 야외 시설을 개발할 수 있습니다.

en: <expr=mad>At the mercy of dangerous creatures and SAVAGE BEASTS!
ko: <expr=mad>위험한 생물과 사나운 야수에게 운명을 맡겨 보세요!

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>I do get pretty grumpy in the morning.
<expr=Neutral>Closed off in a small area with a fence and a gate, of course.
ko: <expr=Neutral>물론 울타리와 문으로 막은 작은 구역 안에서요.

en: <expr=Neutral>As you know, patron health and safety are our main concern!
ko: <expr=Neutral>아시다시피 고객님의 건강과 안전이 저희의 최우선 관심사니까요!

en: <expr=Neutral>So any outdoor expansions need to be certified by a forestry specialist.
ko: <expr=Neutral>따라서 모든 야외 확장에는 산림 전문가의 인증이 필요합니다.

en: <expr=cry>Failing to do so will deprive your more adventurous guests from the true experience.
ko: <expr=cry>그렇지 않으면 모험적인 손님들이 진정한 경험을 놓치게 됩니다.
<expr=happy>밖에 앉아 있기 위해 추가 요금을 내는 경험이요!

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Hey, I think I know someone like that!
<expr=Neutral>Were you able to repair a cabin in Pinefall?
<expr=excited>Pinefall Resort is now open for business!
<expr=happy>You're already a certifiable expert at creating incentives for tourists to visit a location.
ko: <expr=happy>이제 관광객이 찾아올 이유를 만드는 공인 전문가시군요.

en: <expr=Neutral>Incentives such as beds and running water.
<expr=Neutral>Which is why I'm not going to waste another second reminding you about it.
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>I should tell Barbara the good news!
<expr=Neutral>Milk smells a bit off but you take a swig anyway? Looking for love?
ko: <expr=Neutral>우유 냄새가 이상한데도 마셔 버리셨나요? 사랑을 찾으시나요?

en: <expr=happy>Announcing our new matchmaking service: Expiration Dates.
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Barbara sent me to fix some cabins.
<expr=mad>Pawn Voyage proudly presents the Pinefall Purlieu!
ko: <expr=mad>폰 보야지가 파인폴 주변 지역을 자랑스럽게 선보입니다!

en: <expr=Neutral>Is what we would love to tell our thousands of excited customers!
<expr=cry>If only anyone knew what that meant.
<expr=Neutral>But before any of that can happen, this old resort requires significant expertise and craftsmanship.
ko: <expr=Neutral>하지만 그러려면 이 낡은 리조트에 상당한 전문 지식과 손재주가 필요합니다.

en: <expr=Neutral>Fix any of the three rundown cabins in Pinefall.
ko: <expr=Neutral>파인폴의 낡은 오두막 세 채 중 하나를 수리하세요.

en: <expr=Neutral>Please. Consult. Your. Local. Placard. For. Further.
<expr=Neutral>And as a reminder to all our valued and unworthy customers.
<expr=happy>Payments are due on the first, third, thirteenth and twentieth of each month.
<expr=Neutral>They say life is meaningless without the satisfaction of a hard day's work.
ko: <expr=Neutral>고된 하루 일과의 만족감 없이는 삶이 무의미하다고들 하죠.

en: <expr=Neutral>Which sets your current efforts at just above pointless!
ko: <expr=Neutral>그러니 지금 고객님의 노력은 무의미함을 간신히 벗어났습니다!

en: <expr=Neutral>You should now strive towards reaching the next level of this totally-not-made-up scale.
ko: <expr=Neutral>이제 전혀 지어내지 않은 이 척도의 다음 단계를 향해 노력하세요.

en: <expr=confused>Words that we hear every day at Pawn Voyage!
<expr=disgust>You wouldn't believe what we hear on our bad days.
ko: <expr=disgust>안 좋은 날에는 무슨 말을 듣는지 믿기 어려우실 겁니다.

en: <expr=happy>What? No, I was following the script!
<expr=disgust>Pawn Vowhat? I don't want to read any of this?
<expr=disgust>Who's there? Is that an animal? All I hear is growling, what kind of job is this?
ko: <expr=disgust>누구야? 동물인가? 으르렁거리는 소리뿐인데, 이게 무슨 일이에요?

en: <expr=disgust>You said this was customer service, not this alligator hunter crap.
ko: <expr=disgust>고객 서비스라고 했잖아요. 이런 악어 사냥꾼 놀이 말고요.

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=scary>I think Oliver said something about that once.
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=scary>올리버가 그런 말을 한 적 있는 것 같아.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Hello? I found a way to be more entertaining.
<stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>Fin? Is that you? Are you back?
<expr=cry>Thank you for... participating in our most recent assignment.
<expr=Neutral>We here at Pawn Voyage value your partnership... greatly.
ko: <expr=Neutral>저희 폰 보야지는 고객님과의 제휴를... 아주 소중히 여깁니다.

en: <stance=HandsUp><expr=happy>It's you! I recognize your voice! How are you?
<expr=cry>We are unable to process your request at this time.
<expr=Neutral>Please consider further developing the property with the appropriate entertainment facilities.
ko: <expr=Neutral>적절한 오락 시설을 추가해 부동산을 더 개발해 주세요.

en: <expr=Neutral>Your property is missing a key entertainment facility. Please rectify this issue.
ko: <expr=Neutral>시설에 핵심 오락 시설이 빠져 있습니다. 문제를 해결해 주세요.

en: <expr=Neutral>Pawn Voyage would like to restate its position as the top highest-scoring multi-layered corporation in its sector.
ko: <expr=Neutral>폰 보야지가 업계에서 가장 높은 점수를 받은 다층적 기업임을 다시 알려 드립니다.

en: <expr=cry>In the bi-annual Employee Wellbeing and Consideration Survey.
ko: <expr=cry>연 2회 실시하는 직원 복지 및 배려 설문 조사에서요.

en: <expr=Neutral>As reported by Pawn Surveys and Polls Incorporated.
ko: <expr=Neutral>폰 설문 및 여론조사 주식회사의 발표에 따르면 그렇습니다.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>I built an arcade. Hey are you ok in there?
<expr=cry>Congratulations. Your efforts have once again raised the net worth of our collaborative property.
ko: <expr=cry>축하합니다. 고객님의 노력으로 공동 부동산의 순자산이 다시 상승했습니다.

en: <expr=Neutral>As the properties in this sector have all been developed to a certain degree of satisfaction.
ko: <expr=Neutral>이 구역의 시설이 모두 어느 정도 만족할 수준으로 개발되었으므로.

en: <expr=cry>This representative is no longer required to offer guidance.
ko: <expr=cry>이 담당자는 더 이상 안내를 제공할 필요가 없습니다.

en: <expr=Neutral>And as such will now cease operation for this location.
<expr=cry>Thank you for joining us in this...
<expr=Neutral>Studies suggest that delayed gratification can be a serious condition.
ko: <expr=Neutral>연구에 따르면 만족을 미루는 것은 심각한 증상일 수 있습니다.

en: <expr=Neutral>Protect yourself and your family TODAY with our 2-for-1 special.
<stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>I think I met your, um, standards.
<expr=happy>Congratulations for once again achieving the most coveted standard of all.
<expr=Neutral>This location has multiple opportunities for further advancement.
<expr=disgust>But our data suggests that your tendency towards a quick and superficial fix.
ko: <expr=disgust>하지만 당사 자료에 따르면 빠르고 겉만 번지르르한 해결책을 선호하시는 성향은.

en: <expr=happy>Is the perfect opening to search for a new expansion location!
<expr=Neutral>Remember, whenever you want to add a new Premium Property to the Pawn Network.
ko: <expr=Neutral>폰 네트워크에 새 프리미엄 시설을 등록하고 싶을 때는 기억하세요.

en: <expr=happy>Find your local Pawn Shark and just press the green button!
ko: <expr=happy>근처의 폰 상어를 찾아 초록색 버튼만 누르시면 됩니다!

en: <expr=thinking>Ever walk into a room and forget why you went in there?
ko: <expr=thinking>방에 들어갔다가 왜 들어왔는지 잊은 적 있어?

en: <expr=wild>Been feeling that since the day I was born.
<expr=thinking>When you're a kid, you cry cause people tell you what to do.
ko: <expr=thinking>어릴 땐 남들이 뭘 하라고 시켜서 울지.

en: <expr=sad>When you grow up, you cry cause people don't tell you what to do.
ko: <expr=sad>크면 아무도 뭘 하라고 안 알려 줘서 울고.

en: <expr=laughing>I just don't do anything anymore. Worked out so far.
ko: <expr=laughing>이젠 그냥 아무것도 안 해. 지금까지는 잘 먹혔어.

en: <expr=Neutral>There ain't a smell in the world that can disgust me.
<expr=mad>I see you're already trying to prove me wrong.
I'm sorry I ever said anything nice about you.
<stance=Hunched><expr=annoyed>I'm sorry I ever said anything nice about you.
<expr=wild>And make sure it never happens again!
Actually, underneath that grubby exterior, I think you're secretly really nice!
ko: 사실 그 꾀죄죄한 겉모습 속에는 정말 착한 마음이 숨어 있는 것 같아!

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>Actually, underneath that grubby exterior, I think you're secretly really nice!
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>사실 그 꾀죄죄한 겉모습 속에는 정말 착한 마음이 숨어 있는 것 같아!

en: <expr=mad>I told you not to say things like that!
<expr=wild>I'm actually THE BIGGEST JERK YOU'VE EVER MET.
ko: <expr=wild>난 네가 만난 놈 중 제일 못된 자식이라고.

en: <expr=angry>And you're probably the biggest one I've ever met!
ko: <expr=angry>넌 내가 만난 놈 중 제일 못됐을 테고!

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>You don't seem to talk a lot either, Gus.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>말도 별로 안 하는 것 같네, 거스.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>That's fair. Well, just wanted to introduce myself.
<expr=laughing>Not exactly putting your best foot forward there.
<stance=Neutral><expr=angry>I think you're being a little rude!
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Actually, I might have a hand in that.
<expr=laughing>Good. They got the best food and baubles.
<stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>You don't seem like a jerk to me.
<expr=mad>We don't take kindly to those types of words.
<expr=laughing>Anyway, they used to roam all over the place. Reminded me of chickens.
<expr=Neutral>Stinky, floating around, afraid of their own shadow, only stopping for the occasional turd.
ko: <expr=Neutral>냄새를 풍기며 떠돌고, 자기 그림자에도 벌벌 떨고, 가끔 똥 쌀 때만 멈췄어.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Well, you might start seeing more of them again.
<expr=Neutral>Doesn't bother me none, as long as they don't stink up the place!
<expr=mad>And maybe don't burn the joint down again.
<expr=sad>All they left last time was a scorched sandwich and half a toilet.
<expr=mad>Fire almost got my my little driving wheel too.
<expr=mad>Worst part is, sandwich turned out to be a stinking leather book. Ask me how I know.
ko: <expr=mad>최악인 건 그 샌드위치가 냄새 나는 가죽 책이었다는 거지. 어떻게 알았는지 물어봐.

en: <expr=thinking>You're not really playing with a full deck are you?
<expr=laughing>Lad, you've got a nice, thick skin on you.
<stance=Hunched><expr=confused>Thanks, I like your skin too I think?
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=confused>고마워. 나도 네 피부가 좋은 것 같아?

en: <expr=wild>HEY! What did I say about saying stuff like that.
<expr=Neutral>So what's a cheeky boy like you creeping around People for?
ko: <expr=Neutral>그래서 너 같은 맹랑한 녀석이 왜 인간들 주위를 어슬렁대?

en: <expr=laughing>Right, right. So making some extra beans on the side?
<expr=Neutral>Getting a kick out of scaring their little moustaches off?
<stance=Hunched><expr=scary>I think they're pretty neat and I like the building part.
<stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>And my buddy Will isn't too upset about the money.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>친구 윌도 돈 버는 걸 싫어하지 않고.

en: <expr=laughing>Bah, what're you gonna use it for? Buying food?
ko: <expr=laughing>흥, 그걸 어따 쓸 건데? 음식을 사게?

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>How come you live out here in the middle of nowhere?
<expr=sad>I prefer it that way, just me, my diddly little self and I.
ko: <expr=sad>이게 좋아. 나랑, 조그만 나 자신이랑, 나뿐인 게.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>I get it! You seem pretty cool to hang out with.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>알겠어! 너랑 있으면 꽤 재미있을 것 같아.

en: <expr=angry>Alright enough! One more word like that and I'm done with you!
ko: <expr=angry>그만! 그런 소리 한 번만 더 하면 끝이야!

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=sad>I think we got off on the wrong foot.
<stance=Hunched><expr=bored>I never meant to, um, say nice things about you.
<expr=mad>Yeah well, you can't just do that to people.
<stance=Neutral><expr=mad>But you said pleasant things about me too.
<expr=mad>What are you doing here anyway? Are you following me around? No one comes to Darkgrove.
ko: <expr=mad>아무튼 여긴 왜 왔어? 날 따라다녀? 다크그로브엔 아무도 안 오는데.

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=disgust>I thought I'd start my day off right with a little self-terror.
<expr=laughing>In case I've accidentally given you the impression that I'm a space scientist or something.
ko: <expr=laughing>혹시 내가 우주 과학자라도 되는 줄 알게 했다면 정정하지.

en: <expr=Neutral>I like to scavenge. It's what I do.
ko: <expr=Neutral>난 고물 줍는 걸 좋아해. 그게 내 일이야.

en: <expr=laughing>I get into every nook and cranny and fish out the little artifacts the universe forgot about.
ko: <expr=laughing>구석구석 들어가 우주가 잊은 작은 유물을 낚아 올리지.

en: <expr=thinking>Now, no one's stepped foot in Darkgrove in years.
ko: <expr=thinking>몇 년째 다크그로브에는 아무도 발을 들이지 않았어.

en: <expr=sad>And this tower here is old, like really old.
<expr=Neutral>You can tell by the fact that there isn't a tower anymore.
ko: <expr=Neutral>이제 탑조차 안 남았다는 걸 보면 알 수 있지.

en: <expr=thinking>But that didn't stop Humans from using it anyway.
<expr=Neutral>At least until they up and left, tearing everything down behind them.
ko: <expr=Neutral>떠나면서 뒤에 있는 걸 전부 부숴 버리기 전까지는.

en: <expr=laughing>So like a nerd in a boardgame shop, I dive right in. Getting my little trinket fix.
ko: <expr=laughing>그래서 보드게임 가게에 들어간 덕후처럼 냅다 뛰어들지. 작은 장신구 수집 욕구를 채우려고.

en: <expr=scary>No one can tell me not to!
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Is that how you got your jacket?
<expr=blush>Oh yes, my little green jacket! I found it in the white house up the mountain.
ko: <expr=blush>아, 그래. 내 작은 초록 재킷! 산 위 흰 집에서 찾았지.

en: <expr=laughing>I roll around in the garbage dump once a week to keep it fresh.
ko: <expr=laughing>산뜻하게 유지하려고 일주일에 한 번 쓰레기장에서 뒹굴어.

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>Well, I really like it. It's a nice jacket.
<expr=sad>Ugh, yeah, this old thing? It's actually gotten pretty musty and I can't get the mud smell out of it.
ko: <expr=sad>아, 그래. 이 낡은 거? 퀴퀴해졌는데 진흙 냄새가 안 빠져.

en: <expr=laughing>Hey, pickings' been slim in the ol' grub department.
<expr=thinking>You wouldn't happen to have anything to gnaw on would ya?
<expr=Neutral>Boy, I'd kill for an Egg Dippy.
<expr=thinking>In fact, I'm pretty sure I have...
You got something for me back there?
Yup! Fresh out of the kitchen.
<expr=ecstatic>Tastes like I'm about to do something useful.
ko: <expr=ecstatic>뭔가 쓸모 있는 일을 하게 될 것 같은 맛이야.

en: <expr=Neutral>You make a mean Egg Dippy, big boy.
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Thanks! I didn't lay it, only cooked it.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>고마워! 달걀을 낳은 건 아니고 요리만 했어.

en: <expr=laughing>We used to get egg dippy maybe once a year if that.
ko: <expr=laughing>예전엔 일 년에 한 번 먹기도 힘들었지.

en: <expr=sad>My poor ma'. I don't blame her. She did the best she could.
ko: <expr=sad>우리 불쌍한 엄마. 탓하진 않아. 최선을 다하셨어.

en: <expr=Neutral>We were twelve brothers and she had to carry us all on her back.
ko: <expr=Neutral>우린 형제가 열둘인데 등에 다 업고 다니셔야 했거든.

en: <expr=cry>And we were all little dumbasses too, driving her up the wall.
ko: <expr=cry>전부 멍청한 꼬마들이어서 엄마 속을 뒤집어 놓기도 했고.

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=scary>Oh man, I don't think my mom could've handled more than one Hank.
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=scary>아이고, 우리 엄마는 행크가 하나만 더 있어도 못 버티셨을걸.

en: <expr=laughing>Hah, I remember one time, my two older brothers and I got up in the middle of the night to steal the pudding.
ko: <expr=laughing>하, 한번은 형 둘이랑 한밤중에 일어나서 푸딩을 훔쳤거든.

en: <expr=scary>And we accidentally dropped the whole bowl from the 3rd floor.
<expr=thinking>I swear her mouth was spouting fire.
<expr=sad>I thought I was for sure dying that night. I wasn't allowed out of the hole for 3 days straight.
ko: <expr=sad>그날 밤 죽는 줄 알았어. 꼬박 3일 동안 구멍 밖으로 못 나왔지.

en: <expr=laughing>Yeah, that wasn't even the longest I got put in the hole.
<stance=Hunched><expr=confused>Did she ever put you someplace nice when you did something good?
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=confused>잘한 일이 있을 때는 좋은 데 놓아 주시기도 했어?

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=scary>Like uh, a shelf up high somewhere?
<expr=mad>What? No, that's dumb. Besides, I don't remember doing something good, like ever.
ko: <expr=mad>뭐? 아니, 멍청한 소리네. 애초에 좋은 일을 한 기억이 한 번도 없어.

en: <expr=cry>It was like we were twelve devils put on this earth to torment her. And boy were we good at it.
ko: <expr=cry>엄마를 괴롭히려고 세상에 보내진 열두 악마 같았지. 그건 정말 잘했어.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>I don't know. I remember doing a lot of dumb things, but I don't think we ever had a hole.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>글쎄. 나도 바보 같은 짓을 많이 했지만 구멍은 없었던 것 같아.

en: <expr=laughing>Yeah? Well how did you get punished? Forced to eat dish soap? The ol' stick over the paw?
ko: <expr=laughing>그래? 그럼 벌은 어떻게 받았는데? 세제를 억지로 먹였어? 발을 회초리로 때렸나?

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>She usually sat down with me and told me what I did wrong.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>보통 옆에 앉아서 뭘 잘못했는지 말해 주셨어.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>Usually felt bad enough to apologise and never do it again.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>그러면 미안해서 사과하고 다시 안 하게 됐지.

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>Hey you know what? When you're done scavenging, I think I could use some help with the Humans.
ko: <stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>참, 고물 줍는 일이 끝나면 인간들 상대하는 걸 좀 도와주면 좋겠어.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Yeah! See, I'm not a big People bear and I was thinking I needed someone with some heart, some zing.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>응! 난 사람을 잘 대하는 곰은 아니라서. 마음도 있고 활기도 있는 누군가가 필요하거든.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>AND and don't get me wrong, you have a lot of stinky energy.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>그, 오해는 하지 마. 넌 냄새 나는 에너지가 넘치잖아.

en: <stance=HandsUp><expr=happy>But maybe that's exactly what I need from someone running my concierge stand.
ko: <stance=HandsUp><expr=happy>그게 안내 데스크를 맡길 사람에게 꼭 필요한 걸지도 몰라.

en: <stance=HandsUp><expr=ecstatic>Of course! I could use someone scaring some moustaches off a few folks, for a fair price.
ko: <stance=HandsUp><expr=ecstatic>물론이지! 정당한 보수를 받고 사람들 콧수염이 날아가게 겁줄 사람이 필요해.

en: <expr=scary>Well, that's one of the least dumb things you've said today Hank.
ko: <expr=scary>그건 오늘 네가 한 말 중 덜 멍청한 축에 드는군, 행크.

en: <expr=laughing>Listen, if I come and help you, I'll need my own little table, with my own little chair.
ko: <expr=laughing>도와주러 가면 내 작은 책상과 내 작은 의자가 필요해.

en: <expr=ecstatic>A little bready stick dipped inside a creamy egg would really hit the spot right about now.
ko: <expr=ecstatic>지금 부드러운 달걀에 작은 빵 막대를 찍어 먹으면 딱 좋겠네.

en: <expr=Neutral>I never buy, I only sell. That's how you make the big bucks.
ko: <expr=Neutral>난 사지는 않고 팔기만 하지. 그래야 큰돈을 버는 거야.

en: <expr=grumpy>Is something I heard a guy say once.
<expr=Neutral>What do I do with all the money?
<expr=surprised>That's a peculiar question from someone who's minding their own business.
ko: <expr=surprised>자기 일만 신경 쓰는 이가 하기에는 묘한 질문이군.

en: <expr=Neutral>You seem like you barely know how to put one foot in front of the other.
ko: <expr=Neutral>넌 발을 번갈아 내딛는 법도 겨우 아는 것 같구나.

en: <expr=grumpy>Tell me child, do you reckon with the wild?
ko: <expr=grumpy>말해 보렴, 아이야. 야생과 맞서 본 적 있느냐?

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>I’ve been known to occasionally look away in the distance.
<expr=grumpy>No? I didn’t think so. You don’t look the part.
ko: <expr=grumpy>없겠지? 그럴 줄 알았다. 생긴 것도 그렇지 않으니.

en: <expr=Neutral>You’ve never set foot in a shadow darker than your mother’s.
ko: <expr=Neutral>어미의 그림자보다 어두운 곳에는 발을 들인 적도 없구나.

en: <expr=Neutral>If you think these lands are young, you are greener than the crudest sapling!
ko: <expr=Neutral>이 땅이 젊다고 생각한다면 넌 어린 묘목보다도 풋내기다!

en: <expr=surprised>THERE IS NOTHING TO FEAR BUT THOSE WHO FEAR NOTHING!
<stance=Hunched><expr=confused>What the hell are you talking about?
<expr=Neutral>Ugh, fine, I guess I'm lucky to stumble upon something with pockets.
ko: <expr=Neutral>흥, 좋아. 주머니 달린 무언가를 만난 걸 다행으로 여겨야겠군.

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=annoyed>Did you just call me a something?
<expr=grumpy>I hope for your sake that they're not empty.
<expr=Neutral>Say, you wouldn't happen to know anything about all the Humans showing up out of nowhere would you?
ko: <expr=Neutral>참, 갑자기 나타나는 인간들에 대해 아는 게 있느냐?

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=blush>I, uhm, might have had a hand in that.
<expr=Neutral>Well, there's no stopping them now, is there?
<expr=grumpy>Once they start coming back, they'll keep coming.
<expr=happy>I won't complain, business has been slow since that dreadful blaze.
ko: <expr=happy>불평은 않겠다. 그 끔찍한 화재 이후로 장사가 뜸했거든.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=sad>I didn't know the fire reached all the way out here.
<expr=sad>Oh the fire wasn't even close to the worse of it lad.
<expr=cry>The shouting, the anger, the pain. As if the GODS were waging war over us.
ko: <expr=cry>고함과 분노와 고통. 신들이 우리 위에서 전쟁이라도 벌이는 것 같았지.

en: <expr=Neutral>Anyway, you might be taking care of the Motel, but there's a clear lack of stuff to bite on around here.
ko: <expr=Neutral>아무튼 모텔은 돌본다지만 이 근처에는 먹을 게 턱없이 부족해.

en: <expr=Neutral>Something that old Diner was a sweet spot for.
ko: <expr=Neutral>옛 식당이 그런 걸 해결하기 딱 좋았지.

en: <expr=happy>If you can get it back up to speed, I'm pretty sure you'll get more People to come over.
ko: <expr=happy>다시 운영할 수 있으면 사람들이 더 찾아올 거다.

en: Going, going, gone! I mean, done!
<expr=grumpy>You should know, child, there is nothing more treacherous on this green earth than Humans. Those bald gremlins.
ko: <expr=grumpy>알아 두렴, 아이야. 이 푸른 땅에 인간만큼 믿을 수 없는 것도 없다. 털 없는 악귀들이지.

en: <expr=sad>They know nothing of this world yet they consume it.
<expr=surprised>THE DARK SPIRIT WILL BE ANGRY WITH THEIR RETURN!
<stance=HandsDown><expr=scared>You really freak me out when you do that.
<expr=Neutral>I suppose they do bring their own fortunes.
<expr=grumpy>Which of course they don't share willingly. We have to prey or become prey.
ko: <expr=grumpy>물론 순순히 나눠 주지는 않아. 사냥하거나 사냥감이 되거나.

en: <expr=Neutral>I don't suppose you've had any, eh... bad dreams lately.
ko: <expr=Neutral>혹시 요즘 어... 나쁜 꿈을 꾸지는 않았겠지.

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=blush>N...no! None! I sleep like a baby!
<expr=happy>Don't worry, she only bites when she's told.
<expr=happy>And there's no one to tell her yes.
<expr=grumpy>I'm pretty sure that's not what an upscale dining establishment is supposed to look like.
<expr=happy>Fancy seeing you still carrying all of your limbs.
<expr=Neutral>You might be smarter than I thought, child.
<expr=grumpy>See, you walking around without a care in the world.
<expr=sad>Just sheds light on the fact that you still haven't succumbed to the futility of it all!
ko: <expr=sad>모든 일의 헛됨에 아직 굴복하지 않았다는 걸 보여 주지!

en: <expr=grumpy>No, not the futility of walking around!
<expr=Neutral>It is the nonchalant absent-mindedness that signals your weakness to the world!
ko: <expr=Neutral>그 태평하고 정신 나간 모습이 세상에 약점을 드러낸다는 뜻이다!

en: <expr=grumpy>Yes, your inattention towards the worthlessness of your actions in the grand scheme of things!
ko: <expr=grumpy>그래. 큰 그림 속에서 네 행동이 얼마나 무가치한지 무심하다는 점이지!

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>So I don't care about the fact that nothing matters?
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>아무 의미 없다는 사실을 제가 신경 안 쓴다고요?

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>But if nothing matters, why should I care about it?
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>아무 의미 없으면 왜 신경 써야 해요?

en: <expr=Neutral>Because! Because erm... You must let go! Yes! Let go of all material wants and needs!
ko: <expr=Neutral>그야! 그야 어... 놓아야 하니까! 그래! 물질에 대한 모든 욕망과 필요를 놓아라!

en: <expr=sad>As they will only lead to the same nothingness!
<expr=cry>The empty void that we are all on the same journey towards.
ko: <expr=cry>우리가 모두 함께 향하는 텅 빈 공허로.

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>Can I at least have a snack on the way?
<expr=happy>I could really go for some stromboli right about now.
<expr=surprised>Oh it's out of this world! If you find any, grab me one too!
ko: <expr=surprised>아, 세상 밖의 맛이지! 찾으면 내 것도 하나 가져오렴!

en: <expr=happy>Oh that heavenly smell. Give it here!
<expr=Neutral>Mmmh, well. I do say this is one of the most delectable pastries I've had in a while.
ko: <expr=Neutral>음, 그래. 최근 먹은 빵 요리 중 가장 맛있는 축에 드는구나.

en: <expr=happy>Where did you purchase such a thing?
<expr=Neutral>Your poise in the face of inevitable darkness is inspiring, child.
ko: <expr=Neutral>피할 수 없는 어둠 앞에서도 태연하다니 감명 깊구나, 아이야.

en: <expr=happy>You remind me of a younger boy, driven by a fiery heart and an empty brain.
ko: <expr=happy>불타는 가슴과 텅 빈 머리로 움직이던 어린 녀석이 떠오른다.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>Me? Do I remind you of me?
<expr=surprised>ME! Well, a younger version of me.
<expr=grumpy>Of course now I know that striving towards any achievement is like trying to mop away the ocean.
ko: <expr=grumpy>물론 지금은 무엇을 이루려 애쓰는 게 대걸레로 바다를 치우는 꼴임을 알지.

en: <expr=Neutral>But this stromboli has given me a reinvigorated outlook.
ko: <expr=Neutral>하지만 이 스트롬볼리 덕분에 새롭게 의욕이 생겼구나.

en: <expr=happy>I will pay my favour to you immediately.
<expr=Neutral>You emanate a lot of energy, child.
<expr=grumpy>None of which comes from stromboli. Begone!
<expr=grumpy>You certainly took your time, but I guess you've made that aspect of your life clear.
ko: <expr=grumpy>참 느긋하게 왔구나. 삶의 그런 면은 이미 잘 보여 줬지만.

en: <expr=Neutral>I used to roam these lands just like you.
<expr=Neutral>In search of nothing at all, with but the wind to keep me company.
<expr=grumpy>Long before the true nature of existence was revealed to me by the ancient ones.
ko: <expr=grumpy>고대의 존재들이 내게 실존의 본질을 알려 주기 훨씬 전에.

en: <expr=Neutral>But, that doesn't mean our painfully worthless lives also have to be insipid.
ko: <expr=Neutral>그렇다고 고통스러울 만큼 무가치한 삶이 재미없기까지 할 필요는 없지.

en: <expr=grumpy>I will grant you the great honour...
<stance=><expr=happy>Of being able to give me money more easily.
ko: <stance=><expr=happy>내게 더 쉽게 돈을 바칠 수 있는 영광을.

en: <expr=Neutral>By setting up my old travel cart here.
<expr=Neutral>For your effort, I will also grant you access to my rarest goods.
ko: <expr=Neutral>네 노력의 대가로 가장 희귀한 상품도 살 수 있게 해 주마.

en: <expr=grumpy>One day you will wake up to our predetermined collective future.
ko: <expr=grumpy>언젠가 너도 정해진 우리의 공동 미래를 깨닫겠지.

en: I've got something to show you.
<expr=Neutral>Seek Charlotte in Blackmoss with that piece of scrap. I mean... precious metal.
ko: <expr=Neutral>그 고철... 아니, 귀금속을 가지고 블랙모스의 샬럿을 찾아가거라.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>The old lady from Pinefall asked me to bring this to you.
<stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>She said something about secrets. And gullible people.
<expr=Neutral>I see it now, this isn't your average piece of scrap. This is from the old world.
ko: <expr=Neutral>이제 보이는구나. 평범한 고철이 아니야. 옛 세상에서 온 물건이지.

en: <expr=grumpy>Taken from the great... magnificent Junk Heap.
<expr=Neutral>Look, this special artefact needs to be uhhh... resonated! Yes!
ko: <expr=Neutral>봐라, 이 특별한 유물은 어... 공명시켜야 한다! 그래!

en: <expr=Neutral>For it to show its true form, you could never comprehend.
<expr=grumpy>Yes, well, I'm afraid this needs a more experienced hand than mine.
<expr=Neutral>You might want to show this to a qualified expert.
ko: <expr=Neutral>자격 있는 전문가에게 보여 주는 게 좋겠다.

en: <expr=happy>Take it to Charlotte, the old crone.
<expr=Neutral>She'll have an answer to your little inquiry.
<expr=happy>Nothing better to soothe the cold than 4 hours in the sauna.
ko: <expr=happy>추위를 달래는 데 사우나 4시간만 한 게 없지.

en: <expr=excited>Dogs don't sweat because there's no such thing as being too warm.
ko: <expr=excited>개는 땀을 흘리지 않아. 너무 따뜻하다는 건 없으니까.

en: <expr=annoyed>In this weather even my fleas could use an extra layer.
ko: <expr=annoyed>이런 날씨에는 내 벼룩도 옷을 한 겹 더 입어야겠군.

en: <expr=excited>Oh the air suddenly feels a little warmer.
ko: <expr=excited>오, 갑자기 공기가 조금 따뜻해진 것 같군.

en: <expr=Neutral>It's rare that I don't have to look downwards to speak to someone.
ko: <expr=Neutral>아래를 보지 않고 누군가와 말하는 건 드문 일이야.

en: <expr=thinking>Even rarer to not have to look up to face one of your kind.
ko: <expr=thinking>너 같은 종족을 올려다보지 않는 건 더 드물고.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=angry>Did you just compliment and snub me at the same time?
<expr=Neutral>Neither, or do any good to the mind.
<expr=sad>I will praise or condemn only deeds.
<expr=Neutral>Not things you had no hand in.
<stance=Hunched><expr=sad>It's okay, I don't like getting either.
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=sad>괜찮아요. 전 둘 다 받는 걸 안 좋아해요.

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=confused>I don't know what to do with them.
<expr=excited>What does a young brown bear need from a frigid place like this?
ko: <expr=excited>젊은 불곰이 이런 추운 곳에는 무슨 일인가?

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>I'm putting together a group of remarkable friends to save the world.
<stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>No, but now you might actually believe the second thing now.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>아뇨. 하지만 이제 두 번째 얘기는 믿으시겠죠.

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>I'm rebuilding things throughout the Valley and...
<stance=HandsUp><expr=happy>And bringing back Humans because of a greedy Shark.
ko: <stance=HandsUp><expr=happy>욕심 많은 상어 때문에 인간들을 다시 불러 모으고 있어요.

en: <stance=HandsUp><expr=ecstatic>What do you mean why? Because the inflatable fish said so.
<expr=thinking>So it's the kindness in your soul, then?
<stance=Hunched><expr=scary>Oh and I'm also looking for something, uh.
<expr=thinking>Well, Hank, that might be something I could help you with.
<expr=sad>But I'd like to see that group you're putting together first.
ko: <expr=sad>하지만 모으고 있다는 그 무리부터 보고 싶네.

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>I can... get started on building stuff!
<expr=Neutral>Make sure that kindness eventually finds its way back.
<stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>Yes, well, as you know, I'm putting together a group...
<expr=happy>Of remarkable people to save the world, yes.
<stance=Hunched><expr=scary>Right. And you know, the world is a lot colder than they thought.
<expr=excited>It can certainly bristle the coat on your back.
<stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>And I was wondering, if this group of, you know, extraordinary beings.
ko: <stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>그래서 그런데, 그 특별한 존재들의 무리가 말이에요.

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=blush>Needed to get extraordinarily warm, even for a little bit.
<stance=Neutral><expr=coy>And their laser eyes weren't working today.
<expr=happy>How would they get around to keeping warm?
<stance=HandsDown><expr=blush>Not that they don't know, of course they do!
<stance=HandsDown><expr=disgust>But they also couldn't help but notice the thick fur and fireplace back there.
ko: <stance=HandsDown><expr=disgust>다만 두꺼운 털이랑 뒤에 있는 벽난로가 눈에 띄어서요.

en: <expr=thinking>I see. Yes, well, I would reckon these incredible people.
<expr=Neutral>Would have to first go on a critical mission.
<expr=ecstatic>Yes, yes, a mission of great importance! A rescue and recovery mission.
ko: <expr=ecstatic>그래, 아주 중요한 임무! 구출 및 회수 임무지.

en: <stance=HandsUp><expr=ecstatic>They would be willing, no, INCLINED to go on this mission!
ko: <stance=HandsUp><expr=ecstatic>그들은 기꺼이, 아니 아주 하고 싶어 할 거예요!

en: <expr=sad>The secret riches they would be so inclined to fetch are located near the coastline.
ko: <expr=sad>그토록 구하고 싶은 비밀 보물은 해안 근처에 있다네.

en: <expr=excited>In Whitestone Bay, a box of highly delicate material can be found near the end of the cliff.
ko: <expr=excited>화이트스톤 베이 절벽 끝 근처에 아주 섬세한 재료가 든 상자가 있어.

en: <expr=excited>It is of the upmost importance that this objective is retrieved and delivered to me.
ko: <expr=excited>그 목표를 회수해 내게 전달하는 건 대단히 중요하네.

en: <expr=thinking>And then we can see about warming up this crew.
ko: <expr=thinking>그다음 그 무리를 따뜻하게 할 방법을 보지.

en: <expr=happy>Thank you, my friend. You are a good bear.
<stance=Neutral><expr=mad>Wait, I don't know how to feel about that one.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>잠깐, 그 말은 어떻게 받아들여야 할지 모르겠어요.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>I thought compliments weren't good for you.
<expr=Neutral>But you weren't born a good bear, your made yourself into one.
ko: <expr=Neutral>하지만 자네는 좋은 곰으로 태어난 게 아니라 스스로 좋은 곰이 되었지.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=sad>Well, neither feel like the truth to me.
<expr=sad>Either way, it's you that has to give the green light.
<expr=Neutral>I see you're still on the hunt for my sauna stones. I'm looking forward to receiving them.
ko: <expr=Neutral>아직 사우나 돌을 찾는 중이군. 기다리고 있겠네.

en: <expr=happy>Let's see about warming up shall we?
<expr=thinking>That hot head of yours can only radiate so much warmth.
ko: <expr=thinking>자네의 뜨거운 머리만으로 낼 수 있는 열에는 한계가 있지.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>I don't want to brag but, it is positively steaming.
<expr=annoyed>Yes, well eventually you'll have to burn a couple of logs.
ko: <expr=annoyed>그래, 그래도 결국 장작은 좀 태워야 할 거야.

en: <expr=Neutral>Take this and make a little heating room.
<expr=thinking>I'll show you how to turn it on after.
<expr=Neutral>Have you made a home for your heater yet?
<expr=happy>Then it is only fair that you put it to good use.
<expr=bored>I see you still haven't built a room for that heater.
<expr=Neutral>Come back to me once that's done.
<expr=thinking>It will allow the flame to put up a good fight against the cold.
ko: <expr=thinking>불꽃이 추위에 잘 맞서 싸울 수 있을 거야.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=angry>Okay good, because I've tried the fire thing before and it doesn't run great on just eyebrows.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=angry>좋네요. 전에 불을 써 봤는데 눈썹만으로는 잘 안 타더라고요.

en: <expr=thinking>Make sure you give it plenty of friends to keep it company.
<expr=Neutral>The fire is hungriest when met with the strongest opposition.
ko: <expr=Neutral>불은 가장 거센 적을 만날 때 가장 배고프다네.

en: <expr=thinking>You can get all the fuel you need at my little stand.
ko: <expr=thinking>필요한 연료는 내 작은 가판대에서 모두 구할 수 있어.

en: <expr=thinking>Those steamy sauna rocks don't come cheap you know.
ko: <expr=thinking>김 나는 사우나 돌은 싼 게 아니거든.

en: <expr=Neutral>How goes the heating adventure? Were you able to nourish the fire?
<expr=happy>Good! You're almost a master of a craft now.
<expr=excited>Well, don't be fooled. The fire runs out quickly without a keen eye to watch over it.
ko: <expr=excited>하지만 방심하지 마. 주의 깊게 돌보지 않으면 불은 금방 꺼지네.

en: <expr=thinking>Make sure you give it plenty of light and water it everyday.
<stance=Neutral><expr=mad>But for a second there I was about to go get a bucket.
<expr=Neutral>Let me know if you're having trouble putting a little something into a bigger something.
ko: <expr=Neutral>작은 걸 큰 것 안에 넣는 데 어려움이 있으면 말하게.

en: <expr=sad>Because then we'd be in for a much, much longer road ahead.
ko: <expr=sad>그렇다면 앞으로 갈 길이 훨씬, 훨씬 길어질 테니.

en: <expr=happy>Nice of you to drop by again.
<expr=thinking>Good to see your tail hasn't fallen off yet.
<expr=Neutral>You mentioned you had an more nuanced reason for jeopardizing your posterior in this cold.
ko: <expr=Neutral>이 추위에 엉덩이를 위험에 빠뜨리는 더 미묘한 이유가 있다고 했지.

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>A friend asked me to go look for something unfamiliar to cook!
ko: <stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>친구가 요리에 쓸 낯선 재료를 찾아 달랬어요!

en: <expr=annoyed>I'm not familiar with what your friend is not familiar with.
<stance=Neutral><expr=mad>That word doesn't sound real to me anymore.
<expr=thinking>Which word? I'm not familiar with it.
<stance=Hunched><expr=annoyed>I liked you more before the sense of humor came out swinging.
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=annoyed>유머 감각을 그렇게 휘두르기 전이 더 좋았어요.

en: <expr=happy>Yes, well, some things have a way of thawing out of you in the sauna.
ko: <expr=happy>그래, 사우나에 있으면 속에서 뭐가 녹아 나오기도 하지.

en: <expr=Neutral>But, I did say I could help with your tasty quest in exchange for our little mission.
ko: <expr=Neutral>하지만 작은 임무의 대가로 맛있는 탐색을 돕겠다고 약속했지.

en: <expr=surprised>And I'm adamant that your friend hasn't cooked with one of these yet.
ko: <expr=surprised>자네 친구가 아직 이것으로 요리한 적은 없을 거라 확신하네.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>I prefer to eat the things that don't hurt my food hole.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>전 먹는 구멍을 아프게 하지 않는 음식이 좋아요.

en: <expr=excited>On the contrary! Anything that's worth its weight in salt needs a little contrast.
ko: <expr=excited>반대지! 제값을 하는 것에는 약간의 대비가 필요해.

en: <expr=Neutral>All of this snow would be nothing but glacial misery if not for a little fire.
ko: <expr=Neutral>작은 불이 없다면 이 눈은 얼음 같은 고통뿐일 테니까.

en: <expr=sad>I saved this lemon tree from the old Greenhouse down the road.
ko: <expr=sad>길 아래 옛 온실에서 이 레몬 나무를 구했네.

en: <expr=Neutral>Soft, green life was not high on the list of protection against harm.
ko: <expr=Neutral>부드러운 초록 생명은 보호해야 할 목록에서 순위가 낮았지.

en: <expr=thinking>But this one sapling survived long enough to be evacuated.
ko: <expr=thinking>하지만 이 묘목 하나는 피신시킬 때까지 살아남았네.

en: <expr=Neutral>And in exchange for its life, it offered us its endurance.
ko: <expr=Neutral>목숨을 구해 준 답례로 끈질긴 생명력을 우리에게 주었지.

en: <expr=thinking>Which I now pass on to you and your friend.
<expr=Neutral>And if your friend would need some more zest in the future.
<expr=happy>Tell them a hardened but comical character would be glad to offer it.
ko: <expr=happy>산전수전 다 겪었지만 농담도 할 줄 아는 이가 기꺼이 제공하겠다고 전해 주게.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>I'm not familiar with who you're talking about.
<expr=thinking>HAH! So there is a funny bone in there somewhere.
<expr=Neutral>Go ahead, I'm sure your friend is waiting for that lemon.
<expr=happy>Well if it isn't our gracious host.
<stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>I've been meaning to ask, how did you end up here?
<expr=Neutral>Well, like most of our kind here, we often lived in the shadows of Humans.
ko: <expr=Neutral>이곳의 우리 같은 동물들처럼 인간의 그림자 속에 살았지.

en: <expr=bored>Those of us they had a use for.
<expr=Neutral>I was lucky to be large enough that even your kind would have second thoughts.
ko: <expr=Neutral>다행히 난 덩치가 커서 자네 같은 종족도 다시 생각해야 했어.

en: <expr=thinking>About finding that last snack before bed on the Ski Grounds.
ko: <expr=thinking>스키장에서 자기 전 마지막 간식을 찾는 일 말이지.

en: <expr=annoyed>That and, of course, my coat being thick enough to survive outside.
ko: <expr=annoyed>물론 바깥에서도 살아남을 만큼 털이 두꺼웠던 덕도 있었고.

en: <expr=sad>Others that were brought along were not as fortunate.
ko: <expr=sad>함께 끌려온 다른 이들은 그리 운이 좋지 못했어.

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=confused>There's always a fire running in your home though.
<expr=bored>And I'm quite certain it will stay that way until the day I lay down for my last nap.
ko: <expr=bored>마지막 낮잠을 자러 눕는 날까지 그럴 거라 확신하네.

en: <expr=Neutral>You can grow a thick skin and a warm coat.
ko: <expr=Neutral>피부를 두껍게 하고 털을 따뜻하게 기를 수는 있지.

en: <expr=annoyed>But no one deserves to sleep out in the cold all their life.
ko: <expr=annoyed>하지만 평생 추위 속에서 잘 자격이 있는 이는 없네.

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=scary>I only need 5 seconds outside to agree to that.
<expr=Neutral>However, when the Humans had a reason for celebration.
<expr=happy>I remember how we all gathered around the television and watch other Humans tell them stories.
ko: <expr=happy>TV 앞에 다 같이 모여 다른 인간들이 들려주는 이야기를 보던 기억이 나네.

en: <expr=thinking>Like a magical bonfire, keeping us all entranced.
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Will does that too, he makes us watch them with him.
<stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>He keeps watching after we all doze off and he's still there the next day.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>우리가 다 졸아도 계속 보고, 다음 날에도 그 자리에 있어요.

en: <expr=Neutral>Stories are sometimes all we have when reality doesn't suit us very well.
ko: <expr=Neutral>현실이 마음에 들지 않을 때 이야기는 때로 우리가 가진 전부지.

en: <expr=excited>There's a big ruined building in Highlake, you might have passed it on your way here.
ko: <expr=excited>하이레이크에 크고 허물어진 건물이 있어. 오는 길에 지나쳤을 수도 있겠군.

en: <expr=Neutral>That's where the stories used to come from.
<expr=surprised>I'm no expert, but it might have had something to do with the giant radio dish on top of it.
ko: <expr=surprised>전문가는 아니지만 지붕의 거대한 접시 안테나와 관계있을지도.

en: <expr=happy>You might be able to give your guests another chance at those stories.
ko: <expr=happy>손님들에게 그 이야기들을 다시 볼 기회를 줄 수 있겠지.

en: <expr=thinking>If you give the Broadcast Station the same treatment you gave this Ski Resort.
<expr=Neutral>Were you able to fix the station?
Yep! It's back up and running.
<expr=Neutral>You're going above and beyond, which is a rare sight.
ko: <expr=Neutral>시키는 일 이상으로 해내는 건 보기 드문 일이네.

en: <expr=happy>Here, these should help you give your guests a place to watch their stories.
ko: <expr=happy>여기, 손님들이 이야기를 볼 장소를 만드는 데 도움이 될 거야.

en: <expr=thinking>And a nice reprieve from their realities.
<expr=Neutral>The Broadcast Station is in Highlake, on the cliffs to the West.
<expr=Neutral>Have you met the old lady that roams the Valley?
<expr=excited>Yes, her. She roamed the streets of Winterberry not long ago.
ko: <expr=excited>그래, 그분. 얼마 전에 윈터베리 거리를 돌아다녔지.

en: <expr=happy>She was looking for a well-behaved bear with a helpful disposition.
ko: <expr=happy>예의 바르고 남 돕길 좋아하는 곰을 찾고 있었어.

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=surprised>Oh oh! Do you think she found him?
<expr=annoyed>She has a scent about her I haven't sensed in a while.
<expr=Neutral>Walking about the western path from Pinefall, before the landslide closed it off.
ko: <expr=Neutral>산사태로 막히기 전, 파인폴에서 서쪽 길을 걷던 때에 맡았지.

en: <expr=excited>I think she went down the road back to Highlake.
<expr=thinking>Perhaps you can go help her search?
<stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>I sure hope I can help her find him.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>그 곰을 찾도록 도와드릴 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

en: <expr=happy>Oh I'm certain you'll have no trouble at all.
<expr=Neutral>I think you can catch up to Barbara in Highlake, down the road.
ko: <expr=Neutral>길 아래 하이레이크에서 바버라를 따라잡을 수 있을 걸세.

en: <expr=Neutral>We haven't crossed paths in a while.
<stance=Neutral><expr=coy>I'm great! Business is a-boomin'! You know, as they say.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>아주 잘 지내요! 사업이 빵빵 터지거든요! 흔히들 말하듯이요.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>I guess they just didn't get to you yet.
<expr=thinking>Excuse my half-witted attempt at humor. I'm just not myself today.
ko: <expr=thinking>어설픈 농담은 용서하게. 오늘은 내가 나 같지 않군.

en: <expr=annoyed>It's been very cold lately, and no matter how much wood I burn or sauna breaks I take.
ko: <expr=annoyed>요즘 아주 추워. 장작을 아무리 태우고 사우나를 얼마나 자주 가도.

en: <expr=Neutral>Back when this Ski Cabin was at its most popular, People would concoct a lovely drink.
ko: <expr=Neutral>이 스키 산장이 가장 인기 있던 때 인간들이 멋진 음료를 만들곤 했지.

en: <expr=excited>You only needed a sip and it would warm all of your insides.
<expr=happy>Not to mention how delicious it was.
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>The Humans coming over now drink lots of things! We can even make them some!
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>지금 오는 인간들도 이것저것 많이 마셔요! 저희가 만들어 드리기도 하고요!

en: <expr=surprised>Do you think it's something you could try to make yourself? It's not your average tea!
ko: <expr=surprised>직접 만들어 볼 수 있겠나? 보통 차는 아니라네!

en: <expr=Neutral>Let me know if you've had any luck with making that plum schnaps.
<expr=Neutral>Even a small taste hits the spot wonderfully.
<expr=happy>I appreciate you taking time out of your day for me, Hank.
ko: <expr=happy>행크, 나를 위해 시간을 내 줘서 고맙네.

en: <expr=thinking>I understand why you enjoy helping others. It feels good to do so.
ko: <expr=thinking>남을 돕는 걸 왜 좋아하는지 알겠어. 기분 좋은 일이니까.

en: <expr=Neutral>As long as it doesn't come at the cost of your own suffering.
<expr=sad>You cannot give others what you don't have.
ko: <expr=sad>가지지 못한 것을 남에게 줄 수는 없지.

en: <expr=annoyed>I enjoy keeping the flame alive in the face of freezing cold.
ko: <expr=annoyed>난 얼어붙는 추위 앞에서 불을 지키는 게 좋아.

en: <expr=sad>But sometimes I wish I could share the warmth as well. Spread it around.
ko: <expr=sad>하지만 가끔 그 따뜻함을 나누고 싶어. 널리 퍼뜨리고 싶지.

en: <expr=Neutral>If it would be of any use to you, of course.
<expr=happy>Fantastic! I'll need a spot in your resorts to set up my apparatus.
<expr=thinking>I think a little bit of fire will go a long way.
ko: <expr=thinking>작은 불로도 큰일을 할 수 있을 것 같군.

en: <expr=Neutral>I sense something is on your mind.
<expr=happy>Is there anything you'd like to ask me?
Do you know anything about the old building to the west?
ko: 서쪽에 있는 낡은 건물에 대해 아세요?

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>Do you know anything about the old building to the west?
<expr=excited>That is an old mountain shelter, built long before any of the ski cabins were ever started.
ko: <expr=excited>옛 산속 대피소야. 스키 산장들이 들어서기 한참 전에 지었지.

en: <expr=sad>Now it is just a home to a sorrowful fate.
<expr=Neutral>Inside it lives Cian, an elder bearcat that's been in there for a long time.
ko: <expr=Neutral>그 안에 키안이라는 늙은 빈투롱이 오래전부터 살고 있어.

en: <expr=annoyed>But he's also not keen on leaving, as far as I could gather.
ko: <expr=annoyed>내가 보기에는 떠날 마음도 별로 없는 듯하네.

en: <expr=bored>He's not been very responsive to me or anyone over the years.
ko: <expr=bored>오랫동안 나나 다른 이들에게 별다른 반응을 보이지 않았어.

en: <expr=Neutral>You could, of course, try your own luck.
ko: <expr=Neutral>물론 자네가 직접 시도해 볼 수는 있지.

en: <expr=Neutral>Cian is in the old mountain shelter, in western Winterberry.
ko: <expr=Neutral>키안은 윈터베리 서쪽의 옛 산속 대피소에 있네.

en: <expr=excited>So how about you take your watching somewhere else?
<expr=scared>I should really stop getting scared so easily.
<expr=Neutral>There isn't a single food in this world that tastes good without salt.
ko: <expr=Neutral>소금 없이 맛있는 음식은 세상에 하나도 없어.

en: <expr=thinking>Just goes to show that you can't be great without the basics.
<expr=surprised>You are NOT taking anything from the garden!
<expr=scared>Please! There's barely anything left! And the potatoes aren't even in season!
ko: <expr=scared>제발! 남은 것도 별로 없어! 감자는 제철도 아니라고!

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=surprised>Oh, uh, I didn't mean to barge.
<expr=bored>Oh, you didn't? Well, you did anyway!
<expr=sad>Oh, no, um... I didn't mean to come off that way!
ko: <expr=sad>아니, 어... 그런 식으로 말하려던 건 아니야!

en: <expr=blush>I'm sorry, you'll just have to look for food somewhere else.
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Hey, I'll never say no to a warm, glistening potato.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>따뜻하고 윤기 나는 감자를 거절할 생각은 없어요.

en: <expr=sad>Oh, of course, that was so stupid of me to assume.
ko: <expr=sad>아, 그렇겠지. 그렇게 넘겨짚다니 나도 바보 같네.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>That's not even close to stupid, I'll tell you what.
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>I'm Hank. I live in the Thicket with my mom and two best buds.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>전 행크예요. 덤불숲에서 엄마랑 가장 친한 친구 둘과 살아요.

en: <expr=Neutral>It's nice to meet you Hank. I'm Julia. I don't get a lot of visitors.
ko: <expr=Neutral>반가워, 행크. 난 줄리아야. 손님이 많이 오지는 않아.

en: <expr=thinking>Well, I do, but they usually don't talk, they just take.
ko: <expr=thinking>오긴 오는데 대개 말은 안 하고 가져가기만 하지.

en: <expr=sad>And I don't have a lot left to give up.
<stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>I'm not here to take anything, the opposite actually!
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>뭘 가져가러 온 게 아니에요. 사실은 그 반대예요!

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>I was wondering if this old house was occupied. I think it could use a fresh coat of paint.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>이 낡은 집에 누가 사는지 궁금했어요. 페인트칠을 새로 하면 좋겠는데요.

en: <expr=thinking>Well, it used to be. I guess not anymore.
<expr=Neutral>No one's been inside the old Captain's shack in ages.
ko: <expr=Neutral>옛 선장의 집에는 오랫동안 아무도 안 들어갔어.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>Do you mind if I take a look?
<expr=bored>No, but only if you don't mind not going anywhere near my garden.
ko: <expr=bored>괜찮아. 내 텃밭 근처엔 절대 안 가겠다면.

en: <expr=excited>Wow! That house never looked so clean. Is that the fresh coat of paint?
ko: <expr=excited>와! 저 집이 저렇게 깨끗했던 적은 없는데. 새로 칠한 거야?

en: <expr=excited>That's amazing! I've never seen it sparkle like that.
<expr=Neutral>I'm still not sure you're not here for my potatoes.
ko: <expr=Neutral>아직도 내 감자를 노리는 게 아닌지 확신이 안 서.

en: <expr=Neutral>This is the Captain's Estate, and that old pile of rust and mold is the Farmhouse.
ko: <expr=Neutral>여긴 선장의 사유지고, 저 녹과 곰팡이 더미는 농가야.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>Well, significantly less rusty and moldy now.
<expr=Neutral>It used to be the biggest private property in the Valley.
<expr=thinking>The lady Captain and little Captain kids would spend every summer here, although he was never with them.
ko: <expr=thinking>선장 부인과 아이들은 매년 여름을 보냈지만 선장은 같이 있지 않았지.

en: <expr=thinking>He spent most of his time up the hill, in the big radio dish building.
ko: <expr=thinking>대부분 언덕 위의 큰 접시 안테나 건물에 있었어.

en: <expr=Neutral>What made you come up such a long way from home?
<stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>I met a shark that asked me for help to get Humans to come back.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>상어를 만났는데 인간들이 돌아오게 도와 달라고 했어요.

en: <expr=Neutral>If you're here to rob me you don't have to put on a show.
ko: <expr=Neutral>날 털러 온 거면 연기 안 해도 돼.

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=surprised>No! I mean it! There's People all over the place now!
<stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>In fact, I think I could help rebuild the Farmhouse and get People to stay there again!
ko: <stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>사실 농가도 다시 지어서 사람들이 머물게 할 수 있을 것 같아요!

en: <expr=Neutral>I've got a rug in my house that lies less than you.
ko: <expr=Neutral>우리 집 깔개가 너보다 덜 뻔뻔하게 널려 있겠다.

en: <expr=bored>I'm sure your dolphin friend is waiting.
<stance=HandsDown><expr=disgust>Okay, I can prove that I'm not here to steal!
ko: <stance=HandsDown><expr=disgust>좋아요. 훔치러 온 게 아니라는 걸 증명할게요!

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>Isn't there anything you need? I could go get it for you. I'm pretty great at that!
ko: <stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>필요한 거 없어요? 구해 올게요. 제가 그런 건 잘하거든요!
