en: <expr=Neutral>Alright, there's a kind of plant that doesn't grow in Highlake. It's called sage.
ko: <expr=Neutral>좋아. 하이레이크에서 안 자라는 식물이 있어. 세이지라고 해.

en: <expr=Neutral>I use it my teas and peach juice.
<expr=thinking>It doesn't grow in the light, so you won't find it outside the thicker woods.
ko: <expr=thinking>빛이 있으면 못 자라서 울창한 숲 밖에서는 못 찾아.

en: <expr=Neutral>I suggest you look west of Sawdust, but you shouldn't step foot beyond that barrier.
ko: <expr=Neutral>소더스트 서쪽을 살펴봐. 하지만 울타리 너머로 발을 들여서는 안 돼.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>We certainly don't have to worry about that!
<expr=Neutral>I thought you had a whole Farmhouse to repair.
<expr=Neutral>I thought you had a whole Farmhouse to repair.
<expr=Neutral>I'll be honest, I wasn't expecting you back. Did you find any sage?
<expr=surprised>Oh my, it really is! So musty and crisp.
<expr=scared>Did you really go all the way there? To Darkgrove?
<stance=Neutral><expr=coy>Piece of cake! See, bears don't have to worry about underwear!
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>아주 쉬웠어요! 곰은 속옷 걱정을 안 해도 되거든요!

en: <expr=Neutral>Listen, if you're serious about getting this place back on its feet, I think I can help.
ko: <expr=Neutral>정말 이곳을 되살릴 생각이라면 나도 도울 수 있을 것 같아.

en: <expr=Neutral>The Captain's family ate all sorts of food.
<expr=Neutral>They'd grow it in the garden and cook it down into flavors you've never even dreamt of.
ko: <expr=Neutral>텃밭에서 길러 네가 꿈에도 못 꿀 맛으로 요리했지.
<expr=thinking>달콤하고, 새콤하고, 버터 향에, 흙내음에, 훈연 향에, 톡 쏘는 맛까지.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>I didn't know I could taste words before.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>말에서 맛이 느껴질 수 있는 줄은 몰랐어요.

en: <expr=Neutral>And well, I know for a fact your Humans are going to want some.
ko: <expr=Neutral>그리고 인간 손님들이 그걸 원할 거라는 건 확실히 알아.

en: <expr=excited>So I can teach you how to do that...
ko: <expr=excited>그러니까 내가 방법을 가르쳐 줄 수 있어...

en: <expr=surprised>Great! I mean, I'm happy to hear that.
<expr=Neutral>You can help yourself from the garden. Things grow pretty fast in there, so help yourself!
ko: <expr=Neutral>텃밭에서 필요한 걸 가져가도 돼. 금방 자라니까 마음껏 써!

en: <expr=thinking>Now, the Captain had a big table the whole family would sit around.
ko: <expr=thinking>선장 집에는 온 가족이 둘러앉는 큰 식탁이 있었어.

en: <expr=Neutral>You should probably give folks some room to eat.
<expr=bored>I don't recall you saying you'd come back empty-handed.
<expr=excited>I can't believe you're going through all this trouble.
<expr=sad>Ahem. I'm sorry. I've been by myself for a long time.
<expr=sad>There's barely a soul that passes through here these days.
<expr=thinking>Except the ones who make a fuss at night, I guess.
<expr=scared>But I don't have the guts to confront them.
<expr=Neutral>Anyway, you've got everything you need to start making some delicious food.
ko: <expr=Neutral>아무튼 맛있는 음식을 만들 준비는 전부 됐어.

en: <expr=excited>Oh except, like, the one important bit. Somewhere to cook it all!
<expr=Neutral>Now, I did my best with what I had in the guest house.
ko: <expr=Neutral>난 손님용 집에 있는 걸로 최선을 다했어.

en: <expr=blush>But I'm pretty proud of my little kitchen.
<expr=Neutral>And I expect you to make your own!
<expr=Neutral>Come back when the dining room is ready.
<expr=Neutral>Did you manage to get a kitchen up and running?
<expr=Neutral>Time to give it its maiden voyage!
<stance=Neutral><expr=blush>I haven't exactly won any cooking competitions out there.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>제가 요리 대회에서 우승해 본 건 아닌데요.

en: <expr=blush>Oh nonsense! You're a natural, I can smell it on you.
ko: <expr=blush>아, 무슨 소리야! 넌 타고났어. 냄새만 맡아도 알아.

en: <expr=Neutral>Look, here's some basics to get you started.
ko: <expr=Neutral>자, 시작할 수 있게 기초를 알려 줄게.

en: <expr=thinking>I'm sure not everyone's gonna be picky from the get go!
<expr=Neutral>Grab some taters from the garden and some mint next to the lake.
<expr=Neutral>And give your new kitchen a spin.
<expr=Neutral>Come back when the kitchen is ready!
<expr=thinking>But it's better than my first try!
<expr=excited>Alright now, you better go serve it before it gets cold.
<expr=Neutral>Not smelling any taters or tea on you.
<expr=Neutral>Well, congrats Hank! You just cooked your first batch of food for someone else.
ko: <expr=Neutral>축하해, 행크! 처음으로 남을 위한 음식을 만들었구나.

en: <expr=Neutral>Now, you better make sure there's always food in there for folks to eat.
ko: <expr=Neutral>이제 사람들이 먹을 음식이 언제나 있도록 해 줘.

en: <expr=thinking>You can make the same stuff, sure, but you'll run out of ingredients quick.
ko: <expr=thinking>같은 걸 계속 만들어도 되지만 재료가 금세 떨어질 거야.

en: <expr=Neutral>So you better learn how to cook more stuff than mash and tea!
ko: <expr=Neutral>그러니 으깬 감자랑 차 말고 다른 요리도 배워야겠지!

en: <expr=Neutral>I've got plenty of recipes from the Captain's cookbook.
<expr=blush>Come by my little booth sometime, I could always use the coin.
ko: <expr=blush>가끔 내 작은 가판대에 들러. 동전은 언제든 환영이야.

en: <expr=Neutral>Go ahead and put the food on the serving table, and make sure you close the lid!
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>No, I get it, I scare myself all the time.
<expr=excited>I mean, of course you're still here.
<expr=sad>I thought you'd be busy with all the People and the houses and everything.
<expr=thinking>Well, I'm not saying you're not, I'm sure those take a lot of work.
ko: <expr=thinking>안 바쁘다는 말은 아니야. 일이 많은 건 알지.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>And skill. And brain. And good looks.
<expr=sad>Ever since you came along, I've been thinking.
<expr=Neutral>I've been stuck in a rut around here.
<expr=blush>Doing the same thing, getting lost in my routine.
<expr=surprised>I don't even mind the sound the big black rock makes at night anymore.
ko: <expr=surprised>이젠 밤에 큰 검은 바위에서 나는 소리도 신경 안 써.

en: <expr=sad>I think I want to try something new!
<stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>Oh I could take you to meet my buds!
<stance=HandsUp><expr=excited>Or, OR, I can introduce you to the Rat Mob!
ko: <stance=HandsUp><expr=excited>아니면, 아니면 쥐 마피아를 소개할 수도 있어요!

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=blush>They're mean, but they have a funny accent so it's ok.
<expr=blush>I was thinking more in the realm of trying out some new recipes to cook!
<stance=Hunched><expr=bored>Oh, yeah, that's fun too, I guess.
<expr=excited>Yes, exactly! Why do I need to go somewhere if I can just get a little taste of it at home?
ko: <expr=excited>맞아! 집에서 조금 맛볼 수 있는데 왜 어딜 가겠어?

en: <expr=thinking>I love my garden, but it doesn't grow a lot of stuff.
<expr=Neutral>Do you think you could try and find me some more unfamiliar ingredients?
ko: <expr=Neutral>좀 더 낯선 재료를 찾아다줄 수 있겠니?

en: <expr=Neutral>Have you found any new ingredients for me?
<expr=Neutral>Hah, see, I didn't get startled this time!
<expr=sad>It's hard to get used to not being surprised by that.
ko: <expr=sad>그게 안 놀라운 일이라는 데 익숙해지기가 어렵네.

en: <expr=Neutral>Did you find what you were looking for?
<stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>Did I ever? I even found what YOU were looking for.
<expr=surprised>Oh my oh golly! That's the ripest lemon I've ever seen!
ko: <expr=surprised>어머 세상에! 이렇게 잘 익은 레몬은 처음 봐!

en: <expr=excited>How did you get it? These don't grow ANYWHERE!
ko: <expr=excited>어떻게 구했어? 이건 아무 데서나 안 자라는데!

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>Oh this bear has a few tricks up his, uh.
<stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>A big furry dog looking thing gave it to me.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>털이 북슬북슬한 큰 개 같은 분이 줬어요.

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=confused>Said he procured it from a glacial Greenhouse or something?
<expr=surprised>The Winterberry Greenhouse! I thought it was gone!
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Well it's still there kind of, more like a BROWNHOUSE now!
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>아직 있기는 해요. 이젠 온실보다는 냉실 같지만요!

en: <expr=blush>This is incredible, I didn't think you could grow things like this anywhere in the Valley!
ko: <expr=blush>대단하다. 계곡 어디서든 이런 걸 기를 수 있으리라곤 생각도 못 했어!

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>Well, you still can't, nothing growing in there but my hate for all things cold.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>아직은 못 길러요. 거기서 자라는 건 추운 것들에 대한 제 증오뿐이에요.

en: <expr=thinking>But we could if you fixed it, right?
<expr=surprised>YES WE COULD! If we have lemon seeds who knows what else we could grow in there!
ko: <expr=surprised>당연히 되지! 레몬 씨앗이 있다면 다른 건 또 얼마나 기를 수 있겠어!

en: <expr=Neutral>Okay alright, I'll need some things. I'll need some plants to get started.
<expr=Neutral>If we get the Greenhouse back up, who knows what delicious things we could cook up!
ko: <expr=Neutral>온실을 되살리면 어떤 맛있는 걸 만들게 될지 모르겠네!

en: <expr=Neutral>Did you find all the stuff for the Greenhouse?
<expr=thinking>Alright, these are good! I think there might be one more thing we need.
ko: <expr=thinking>좋아, 잘 구했어! 필요한 게 하나 더 있을 것 같아.

en: <expr=scared>But I think it'll be harder to get...
<expr=Neutral>Alright so, remember when I asked you to go to the most terrifying place in this Valley.
ko: <expr=Neutral>내가 이 계곡에서 가장 무서운 곳에 가 달라고 했던 거 기억하지?

en: <expr=Neutral>Just to get me some tea flowers?
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>The darkness is permanantely engraved in my brain.
<expr=thinking>So I knew about that place from way before.
<expr=Neutral>The Captain would tell the little kid Captains stories all the time.
ko: <expr=Neutral>선장이 꼬마 선장 아이들한테 늘 이야기를 들려줬거든.

en: <expr=scared>About the scary woods where he'd go and stash stuff.
ko: <expr=scared>물건을 숨겨 놓으러 가던 무서운 숲 이야기.

en: <expr=bored>Stuff they, ahem, found on their boat trips.
<expr=thinking>And sometimes the Captain would bring back a big sack filled with all sorts of grains and seeds.
ko: <expr=thinking>때로는 곡물과 씨앗이 잔뜩 든 큰 자루를 가져오기도 했어.

en: <expr=Neutral>That's how the garden came to be.
<expr=bored>You know, despite being so tall, you've still got a lot of growing up to do.
<expr=excited>Anyway, you need to go fix the Greenhouse for us Hank. For me!
ko: <expr=excited>아무튼 우릴 위해 온실을 고쳐 줘, 행크. 나를 위해!

en: <expr=thinking>But I think you'll need more than just wood and glass.
ko: <expr=thinking>하지만 나무와 유리만으로는 안 될 것 같아.

en: <expr=Neutral>Which I'm pretty sure you've got a good shot at finding in Darkgrove.
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Well, nothing like another hike to the death forest.
<expr=Neutral>Come back when you've fixed the Greenhouse!
<expr=scared>So? So? So? Did you do find it?
<stance=HandsUp><expr=happy>There were all sorts of seeds, beans, beets.
<expr=cry>This is such a dream come true Hank!
<stance=Neutral><expr=coy>Right place at the right time is all.
<expr=excited>Don't sell yourself short big guy, do you know how much cooking we can do with all of this?
ko: <expr=excited>스스로를 낮추지 마. 이걸로 얼마나 많은 요리를 할 수 있는지 아니?

en: <expr=Neutral>Alright, you have some WORK to do.
<expr=Neutral>You're gonna need new equipment! And I'm gonna find some more of the Captain's recipes.
ko: <expr=Neutral>새 장비가 필요할 거야! 난 선장의 요리법을 더 찾아볼게.

en: <expr=blush>You're breathing new life into the Valley.
<expr=scared>Are you doing alright? Do you need anything?
<stance=Neutral><expr=blush>No! Well, maybe. I never knew People could eat that much food...
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>아뇨! 아니, 있을지도요. 사람들이 이렇게 많이 먹는 줄 몰랐어요...

en: <expr=thinking>No matter how much you cook there's always a hungry mouth somewhere!
ko: <expr=thinking>아무리 요리를 해도 어딘가에 배고픈 입이 있으니까!

en: <expr=excited>And they always love the most intricate dishes which are, of course, the hardest to cook!
ko: <expr=excited>언제나 가장 복잡하고, 당연히 만들기도 어려운 요리를 좋아하지!

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>Nu uh! French fries are amazing! Making them sucks...
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>아니요! 감자튀김은 굉장하죠! 만드는 일이 끔찍한 거고요...

en: <expr=blush>Well, if you feel that way, do you think you'd be open to a little help?
ko: <expr=blush>그렇다면 도움을 조금 받아 볼 생각 있니?

en: <expr=sad>Well, it would make me very happy to cook for other folk again.
ko: <expr=sad>다시 다른 이들을 위해 요리하면 정말 행복할 것 같아.

en: <expr=thinking>But I need to know that you're still invested in the food we'd be serving!
ko: <expr=thinking>하지만 우리가 낼 음식에 네가 여전히 관심 있는지는 알아야 해!

en: <expr=Neutral>For that, I need you to prove your love for cooking by making me the most delicious thing ever invented.
ko: <expr=Neutral>그러니 세상에서 가장 맛있는 음식을 만들어 요리를 사랑한다는 걸 증명해 줘.

en: <expr=excited>But not just any kind of cheesecake! A velvety, creamy sous-vide cheesecake!
ko: <expr=excited>그냥 치즈케이크가 아니야! 벨벳처럼 매끄럽고 부드러운 수비드 치즈케이크!

en: <expr=Neutral>Come back with a sous-vide cheesecake, please!
<expr=Neutral>Have you got something delicious for me?
<expr=Neutral>Creamy, lemony top that slightly tickles the tip of your tongue.
ko: <expr=Neutral>혀끝을 살짝 간질이는 레몬 향의 부드러운 윗부분.

en: <expr=excited>Gravelly but crunchy bottom to finish it off!
<expr=blush>You're such a good cook! Careful and observant with all the smallest details.
ko: <expr=blush>정말 좋은 요리사구나! 아주 작은 부분까지 꼼꼼히 살피네.

en: <expr=scared>It's been a long time since I've cooked for anyone other than myself.
ko: <expr=scared>나 말고 다른 이를 위해 요리한 지 오래됐어.

en: <expr=sad>The Captain's family were always many and always hungry and I'm very grateful for what I learned from them.
ko: <expr=sad>선장 가족은 늘 많고 늘 배고팠지. 그들에게 배운 것에 정말 감사해.

en: <expr=blush>I think I'd like to give it another shot.
<stance=HandsUp><expr=happy>I think I'd be a very lucky bear!
ko: <stance=HandsUp><expr=happy>제가 아주 운 좋은 곰이 될 것 같아요!

en: <expr=surprised>Oh my gosh! I can't wait, I have to get my pots and pans and everything!
ko: <expr=surprised>어머나! 얼른 하고 싶다. 냄비랑 팬이랑 전부 챙겨야겠어!

en: <expr=thinking>Anywhere you want me to help, I'll need a little corner of your kitchen, of course.
<expr=excited>But this is a dream come true!
What did you mean about Eris?
ko: 에리스에 관해 하신 말씀은 무슨 뜻인가요?

en: <expr=sad>Eris provided stability for the world while I was indisposed.
ko: <expr=sad>내가 활동하지 못하는 동안 에리스가 세상에 안정을 제공했다.

en: <expr=annoyed>Even though her methods are her own.
<expr=Neutral>It was enough to ground reality, in my absence.
<expr=sad>I was right here, unable to leave.
<expr=Neutral>I had been weakened and imprisoned over the course of years.
ko: <expr=Neutral>약해진 채로 여러 해 동안 갇혀 있었다.

en: <expr=Neutral>Before this, the world had been plunged into disarray.
<expr=thinking>Not a simple chaos that thrives within its own disorder. That would eventually balance itself out.
ko: <expr=thinking>무질서 안에서 번성하는 단순한 혼돈은 아니었다. 그런 것은 결국 균형을 되찾는다.

en: <expr=sad>This was a complex cycle of cruelty and death, orchestrated by another God.
ko: <expr=sad>다른 신이 지휘한 잔혹함과 죽음의 복잡한 순환이었지.

en: <expr=disgust>He had found a way to lure Humans into a false sense of power, permeated through his own potential.
ko: <expr=disgust>자신의 힘을 불어넣어 인간에게 거짓된 권능을 느끼게 할 방법을 찾았다.

en: <expr=annoyed>Humans are the perfect vessels to imbue with a deceiving dominance.
<expr=sad>And so the violence spread and Thyne grew stronger.
<expr=Neutral>As luck would have it, it was also Humans that provided the opposing force required.
ko: <expr=Neutral>다행인지 불행인지, 맞서는 힘을 제공한 것 또한 인간이었다.

en: <expr=thinking>Leading to a boiling energy that eventually had no more space to accumulate.
<stance=HandsDown><expr=surprised>Was that why it happened? Were you there? Wait! Did you see any bears? Did you see my brother?
ko: <stance=HandsDown><expr=surprised>그래서 그런 일이 생겼나요? 거기 계셨어요? 잠깐! 곰도 보셨나요? 제 형을 보셨어요?

en: <expr=annoyed>God's don't usually resolve such a multitude of inquiries.
ko: <expr=annoyed>신은 보통 그렇게 많은 질문을 해결해 주지 않는다.

en: <expr=Neutral>The conflict began after the sun had set.
<expr=sad>Until just now, when someone, somehow did manage to break the stone.
ko: <expr=sad>방금 누군가가 어떻게든 돌을 깨는 데 성공할 때까지.

en: <expr=disgust>Ahhhh. Please allow me another moment to draw my breath.
ko: <expr=disgust>아아. 잠시만 더 숨을 고르게 해 다오.

en: <expr=sad>That is not ours to know, but only the universe's.
<expr=Neutral>I have now been freed from an existence convicted to slumber.
ko: <expr=Neutral>나는 이제 끝없이 잠들어 있어야 했던 운명에서 풀려났다.

en: <expr=cry>A fate I could have never voided on my own.
<expr=annoyed>But hindsight is best left to die alone.
ko: <expr=annoyed>하지만 지난 일을 되짚어 봐야 소용없지. 이제 그만 묻어 두는 게 좋겠다.

en: <expr=thinking>Better than would be expected of you.
ko: <expr=thinking>네게 기대할 수 있는 것보다 더 잘했다.

en: <stance=HandsUp><expr=scared>I don't even know how to do that!
<expr=Neutral>Do not be alarmed, you are not in danger.
<expr=thinking>Not any more than you were a minute ago.
<expr=annoyed>In a sense. Life itself implies the presence of danger to its permanence.
ko: <expr=annoyed>어떤 의미에서는. 살아 있다는 것 자체가 그 지속을 위협하는 위험을 품는다.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>I am not the right bear to talk to about these things.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>저는 그런 얘기를 나눌 만한 곰이 아닌데요.

en: <expr=Neutral>But you are the only one here. The only one that could ever be here.
ko: <expr=Neutral>하지만 이곳에는 너뿐이다. 올 수 있었던 것도 너뿐이었지.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>I'm only here 'cause of the fox telling me to be.
<stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>Well, more like yelling at me for no good reason, but still.
<expr=disgust>Agh-excuse me as I draw my breath for a moment.
ko: <expr=disgust>아, 잠시 숨을 고르는 것을 용서해 다오.

en: <expr=Neutral>There's always something to do around the house.
<expr=annoyed>Anyone that tells you different has never looked behind their fridge.
ko: <expr=annoyed>아니라고 말하는 사람은 냉장고 뒤를 본 적이 없는 거야.

en: <expr=Neutral>If I have trouble falling asleep,I just start reading my book.
<expr=laughing>Guess my brain would rather shut off than read another word, haha.
ko: <expr=laughing>한 글자 더 읽느니 머리가 꺼지는 편을 택하나 봐. 하하.

en: <expr=happy>Make sure you don't leave on an empty stomach.
<expr=surprised>Too much food makes you sleepy, too little just makes you dumb.
<stance=><expr=Neutral>I see you're running low on pocket money.
<stance=><expr=Neutral>Oh my little baby, I knew this day would finally come.
ko: <stance=><expr=Neutral>아, 우리 아가. 언젠가 이날이 올 줄 알았지.

en: <stance=><expr=surprised>Well, I can help you out, but you have to promise to be more careful next time, alright?
ko: <stance=><expr=surprised>도와줄 수는 있지만 다음에는 더 조심하겠다고 약속하렴. 알겠지?

en: <expr=Neutral>Well aren't you a bag of bones!
<expr=laughing>Good to see hibernation hasn't kicked in yet.
<stance=Neutral><expr=mad>You can't call it that every time I get a little extra sleep! Besides...
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>조금 더 잘 때마다 겨울잠이라고 하지 마! 게다가...

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=scary>I had a hard time sleeping... Too many thoughts.
<expr=Neutral>Well, that runs in the family! Have you tried thinking less?
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Oh, in her room with Will, probably. I should go wake 'em up!
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>아마 자기 방에서 윌이랑 있을걸. 깨우러 가야겠다!

en: <expr=Neutral>Good! Today is a very special day! I need you to go...
ko: <expr=Neutral>좋아! 오늘은 아주 특별한 날이야! 너희가 가 줄 곳은...

en: <expr=Neutral>I know I said no going past the fence, but you've all been so good. And I need your help.
ko: <expr=Neutral>울타리 밖에 나가지 말랬지만 너희 모두 착하게 지냈잖니. 그리고 도움이 필요해.

en: <expr=Neutral>The bush around the tombstone is getting a little thick, and the flowers aren't in bloom anymore.
ko: <expr=Neutral>묘비 주변 덤불이 너무 무성해지고 꽃도 더는 안 피더구나.

en: <expr=Neutral>So I'll need you to find me a bundle of alligator weed.
<expr=excited>I can't believe we get to leave this stinkin' place!
ko: <expr=excited>이 냄새 나는 곳을 벗어난다니 믿기지 않네!

en: <expr=Neutral>Anyway, Hank, you're in charge of this operation.
<expr=laughing>Here, this is what I'm looking for. In fact, take the whole Notebook so you don't forget.
ko: <expr=laughing>여기, 이걸 찾는 거야. 잊지 않게 아예 수첩을 가져가렴.

en: <expr=Neutral>Alright, you three. And remember, you're getting that bundle and straight back!
ko: <expr=Neutral>좋아, 너희 셋. 한 다발 구하면 곧장 돌아와야 한다!

en: <expr=surprised>Not one step further than the swamp!
ko: <expr=surprised>늪보다 한 발짝도 더 가면 안 돼!

en: <expr=angry>Hank! Where've you been! My goodness gracious!
<expr=angry>What was in that thick head of yours? And YOU!
ko: <expr=angry>그 둔한 머리로 무슨 생각을 한 거니? 그리고 너!

en: <expr=annoyed>You put him up to this again, didn't you?
<stance=Neutral><expr=mad>No, mom, Will didn't do anything. We weren't even gone that long!
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>아니야, 엄마. 윌은 아무것도 안 했어. 그렇게 오래 나가 있지도 않았고!

en: <expr=sad>I don't suppose anything's wrong with that.
<stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>We're gonna get more to visit, and they'll bring money and trash and we'll get to learn all about them and...
ko: <stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>더 많이 오게 할 거야. 돈이랑 쓰레기를 가져오면 인간에 대해 뭐든 배울 수 있고...

en: <stance=HandsUp><expr=happy>...and I get to make stuff for them! Me! Tony taught me how to build a bed and...
ko: <stance=HandsUp><expr=happy>...그리고 물건도 만들어 줄 수 있어! 내가! 토니가 침대 만드는 법을 가르쳐 줬고...

en: <expr=confused>I haven't heard from him in ages...
<expr=sad>Well, I suppose there was nothing I could do to keep you around anyway.
ko: <expr=sad>어차피 널 곁에만 붙잡아 둘 수는 없었겠지.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>Don't say that, mom. I'm not going anywhere. I just...
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>그런 말 하지 마, 엄마. 어디 안 가. 그냥...

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=sad>It feels nice to do something out there for a change! Something helpful!
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=sad>오랜만에 밖에서 뭔가 하니까 좋아! 도움이 되는 일을!

en: <expr=Neutral>You're all probably exhausted. You should go rest.
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Yeah, we gotta go check on our Humans!
<expr=confused>Alright dear, at least don't forget your hat next time, in case it rains.
ko: <expr=confused>그래, 아가. 적어도 다음엔 비가 올지 모르니 모자는 잊지 마렴.

en: <expr=confused>Are you alright? You seem a little off.
<stance=Neutral><expr=blush>Hey ma'. Yeah, I'm ok. I've got something I need to ask you.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>안녕, 엄마. 응, 괜찮아. 물어볼 게 있어.

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=blush>No, I'm alright. I just... Do you know anything about another bear in the Valley?
ko: <stance=HandsDown><expr=blush>아니, 괜찮아. 그냥... 계곡에 다른 곰이 있다는 얘기 알아?

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=confused>I thought it was just the two of us.
<expr=confused>Um... of course it's just us, dear. Who else could it be?
ko: <expr=confused>음... 당연히 우리뿐이지, 아가. 누가 더 있겠니?

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=scary>I don't remember a lot about the fire. I was so little.
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=scary>불이 났을 때는 잘 기억이 안 나. 너무 어렸잖아.

en: <expr=surprised>Hank, dear. I'm feeling a little cold in my fingers.
<expr=Neutral>Would you mind bringing your old mom a nice hot cup of tea?
ko: <expr=Neutral>늙은 엄마한테 따뜻한 차 한 잔 가져다주겠니?

en: <expr=Neutral>If you wouldn't mind, I could really use a cup of linden tea please, dear.
<expr=laughing>Ah, just a little spicy. It's perfect.
<stance=Hunched><expr=confused>Ma'... Do you know anything about another bear?
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=confused>엄마... 다른 곰에 관해 아는 게 있어?

en: <expr=laughing>You make such great tea, you should open a tea shop!
<stance=Neutral><expr=angry>Oh I don't even know what all the flowers look like, I just like how the water boils- Hey!
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=angry>꽃이 어떻게 생겼는지도 다 모르는데. 그냥 물이 끓는 게 좋을 뿐... 잠깐!

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>Is there something you're not telling me?
<expr=cry>I've never told another soul about this...
<stance=Neutral><expr=blush>I... I don't know what to say.
<expr=sad>You don't have to say anything, Hank. I'm sorry haven't told you, after all this time.
ko: <expr=sad>아무 말 안 해도 돼, 행크. 이렇게 오랫동안 말하지 않아서 미안해.

en: <expr=confused>I was afraid. I thought that if you knew, it would make it real again.
ko: <expr=confused>무서웠어. 네가 알면 다시 현실이 될 것만 같았어.

en: <expr=sad>It would bring the pain back... And it would tempt death again, somehow.
ko: <expr=sad>아픔이 돌아오고... 어떻게든 죽음을 다시 불러들일 것만 같았지.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=angry>No, ma'. No it won't. I wouldn't let it.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=angry>아니야, 엄마. 그런 일 없어. 내가 막을 거야.

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=bored>I understand, it's okay. I'm just... I'm just a little surprised I guess.
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=bored>이해해. 괜찮아. 그냥... 조금 놀란 것 같아.

en: <expr=confused>Artie loved you a lot. He was so strong, but also kind and caring. You were just as much.
ko: <expr=confused>아티는 널 정말 사랑했단다. 아주 강하면서 다정하고 배려심도 많았어. 너도 그랬고.

en: <expr=sad>After that night, I didn't think I was going to make it... But you kept me afloat. You made me keep going.
ko: <expr=sad>그 밤 이후로는 버티지 못할 줄 알았어... 하지만 네가 나를 붙잡아 줬지. 계속 살아가게 해 줬어.

en: <expr=sad>You have nothing to be sorry about, my dear baby boy. You have an amazing and kind soul.
ko: <expr=sad>미안해할 게 없단다, 사랑하는 아가. 넌 놀랍도록 다정한 마음을 가졌어.

en: <expr=Neutral>Which you always share with others... always so carefully.
ko: <expr=Neutral>언제나 다른 이들에게 나눠 주지... 언제나 조심스럽게.

en: <expr=laughing>I'd like you to have this. It's somehow kept Artie close to me all these years.
ko: <expr=laughing>이걸 네게 주고 싶구나. 오랜 세월 어떤 식으로든 아티를 곁에 두게 해 줬어.

en: <expr=sad>I think it's time he was by your side for a while.
ko: <expr=sad>이제는 네 곁에 잠시 있을 때인 것 같아.

en: <expr=confused>It's not your fault, you didn't do anything wrong.
ko: <expr=confused>네 탓이 아니야. 넌 잘못한 게 없단다.

en: <expr=angry>If she wanted to leave, she was going to anyway. It wasn't because of you!
ko: <expr=angry>떠나고 싶었다면 어차피 떠났을 거야. 너 때문이 아니야!

en: <expr=Neutral>Here, I'll make you your favourite honey biscuits.
ko: <expr=Neutral>자, 네가 좋아하는 꿀 비스킷을 만들어 줄게.

en: <expr=grumpy>I had to turn back after an hour. No ship or boat that I could find.
ko: <expr=grumpy>한 시간쯤 가다가 돌아와야 했어. 배는 한 척도 못 찾았어.

en: <expr=sad>I think she's gone for good, buddy.
<expr=angry>Do ya wanna go trash her place? We can go trash her place.
ko: <expr=angry>그 집 엉망으로 만들러 갈래? 같이 가도 돼.

en: <expr=excited>In fact, I'll go ahead and get a head start with that.
<stance=Hunched><expr=sad>I tried so hard to get things back on track. To fix the Valley, step by step...
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=sad>모든 걸 바로잡으려고 정말 애썼어. 계곡을 차근차근 고치려고...

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=sad>To help her get to the bottom of whatever she was looking for. To fix the cabins, the resorts, everything.
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=sad>할머니가 찾던 게 뭐든 끝까지 도와주려고. 오두막도 리조트도 전부 고치려고.

en: <expr=disgust>I didn't trust her to begin with! She'd never stop for ear scratches any time she walked by.
ko: <expr=disgust>난 처음부터 안 믿었어! 지나갈 때마다 귀를 긁어 주지도 않았거든.

en: <expr=bored>Oh I'll give you a sign so clear you'll get right away!
ko: <expr=bored>내가 아주 분명하게 신호를 줘 볼까? 바로 알아들을걸!

en: <expr=confused>I think Hank needs a little space.
<expr=annoyed>Why don't you two go check if your errands have somehow been magically completed, will you?
ko: <expr=annoyed>너희 심부름이 마법처럼 끝나 있기라도 한지 확인하러 가 보렴.

en: <expr=Neutral>Yes ma'am. Hang in there big guy, you'll be alright.
<expr=surprised>You've still got us, Hank! We promise we're not going anywhere.
ko: <expr=surprised>우리 있잖아, 행크! 어디 안 간다고 약속할게.

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=cry>I just don't get it, mom. She was nice to me, and she said nice things too. I really thought I was helping.
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=cry>이해가 안 돼, 엄마. 잘해 주고 좋은 말도 했어. 정말 돕는 줄 알았어.

en: <expr=confused>You did help her, but not in the way you thought.
ko: <expr=confused>도와준 건 맞아. 다만 네가 생각한 방식은 아니었지.

en: <expr=annoyed>I don't know what was going through her head, Hank, but I don't think she ever planned on staying.
ko: <expr=annoyed>무슨 생각이었는지는 모르겠지만, 행크, 머물 계획은 애초에 없었던 것 같구나.

en: <expr=confused>She was going to leave no matter what, you just happened to be her ticket out of here.
ko: <expr=confused>어쨌든 떠날 사람이었어. 네가 우연히 그 탈출표가 된 거지.

en: <expr=sad>I can't blame her. I ran away too, I had a lot less weighing me down and a lot more to fight for.
ko: <expr=sad>탓할 수는 없어. 나도 도망쳤잖니. 내겐 짐이 훨씬 적었고 지켜야 할 건 더 많았어.

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=sad>I don't know what I'm going to do on my own now.
<expr=confused>Same as you've been doing so far! You've been doing such a great job with all of this.
ko: <expr=confused>지금까지 하던 대로 하면 돼! 정말 잘해 왔잖니.

en: <expr=sad>It's alright if you want your life to be about making others happy, so long as you go first.
ko: <expr=sad>남을 행복하게 하는 삶을 살아도 좋아. 다만 네가 먼저 행복해야 해.

en: <expr=confused>You can't give others what you don't have.
ko: <expr=confused>가지지 못한 걸 남에게 줄 수는 없단다.

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=cry>Okay but... What if it's not enough?
<expr=Neutral>It only has to be enough for you. Everything else will follow.
<expr=sad>You did the best you could Hank, for everyone.
<expr=Neutral>Now... get some rest. There's a lot of Humans still waiting for you out there.
ko: <expr=Neutral>이제... 좀 쉬렴. 밖에는 널 기다리는 인간이 아직 많아.

en: <expr=thinking>Always wanted to be a race car driver.
<expr=cry>Not many Bus Grand Prix out there, I'll tell ya.
<expr=happy>I could sit in bed and play video games all day.
<expr=confused>They sure don't make 'em like they used to.
<expr=bored>How do they make 'em? Look bud, I just play 'em.
ko: <expr=bored>어떻게 만드냐고? 친구, 난 그냥 할 뿐이야.

en: <expr=Neutral>Of course I know who's been stealing my sandwiches.
<expr=blush>This week it's lettuce and baloney. I hope they like it.
ko: <expr=blush>이번 주는 양상추와 소시지야. 마음에 들면 좋겠네.

en: <expr=Neutral>Haven't seen your likes around my buses before.
ko: <expr=Neutral>내 버스 주변에서 너 같은 친구는 처음 봐.

en: I would argue you're the rarer sight.
ko: 더 보기 드문 건 아저씨 같은데요.

en: <expr=happy>Oh, what a kind-looking bud you are.
<expr=Neutral>I'm Oliver, I run the buses here if it wasn't evident.
ko: <expr=Neutral>난 올리버야. 보기만 해도 알겠지만 이곳 버스를 운행해.

en: <expr=thinking>Ha! Look at me, of course it's not evident. Bears don't take the bus!
ko: <expr=thinking>하! 내가 무슨 소리람. 당연히 모르겠지. 곰은 버스 안 타잖아!

en: <expr=confused>Do you... do you take the bus?
I've been in a broken down tractor before, does that count?
ko: 고장 난 트랙터에 타 본 적은 있는데, 그것도 쳐 줘요?

en: <expr=happy>I don't see why you couldn't either!
<expr=Neutral>You know what? Do you think you could do me a solid, bud?
<expr=thinking>I've got this letter I've been dying to send.
<expr=scared>But I can't just leave my buses.
<expr=thinking>And there's not been any post since... well... in years!
ko: <expr=thinking>우편도 끊긴 지... 뭐... 몇 년 됐고!

en: <expr=Neutral>You probably know these places better than I do.
<expr=blush>Do you think you could find your way to Sawdust?
<expr=blush>And give this to Beanie for me?
<expr=Neutral>She usually hangs around the Firewatch Tower.
<expr=blush>Did you find Beanie? Did you give her the letter?
<expr=Neutral>She found the rest of it! That's incredible, bud!
<expr=thinking>Oh, drawing all of this out with her was the most fun I ever had.
ko: <expr=thinking>함께 이걸 전부 그리는 일이 내 생애 가장 재미있었지.

en: <expr=happy>Short of driving a bus of course.
<expr=Neutral>Look, there's Sawdust, and Highlake, and look, this is where we are!
ko: <expr=Neutral>봐, 여기 소더스트, 하이레이크. 그리고 여기가 우리야!

en: <expr=thinking>Oh, uh, you probably don't even know what I'm on about.
<expr=scared>This Valley is huge, there's places a bus couldn't even reach!
ko: <expr=scared>계곡은 아주 커. 버스로도 못 가는 곳이 있어!

en: <expr=Neutral>Listen, I've been here for a while, just me and my buses.
ko: <expr=Neutral>난 꽤 오래 여기 있었어. 나와 버스들뿐이었지.

en: <expr=Neutral>But it just don't feel right for us to sit on our tires like that, you know?
ko: <expr=Neutral>하지만 계속 타이어 깔고 앉아 있는 건 아닌 것 같아. 알겠니?

en: <expr=cry>No one's really needed me or my buses in a long time, but with all the new folk starting to visit and all...
ko: <expr=cry>오랫동안 나나 버스가 필요한 사람은 없었지만 새 사람들이 오기 시작하니...

en: <expr=Neutral>I think you should have this, and look, see where these old bus stops are?
ko: <expr=Neutral>이걸 네가 가져. 봐, 옛 버스 정류장들 보이지?

en: <expr=Neutral>If you manage to fix these up like you did with the old storage Shed.
ko: <expr=Neutral>낡은 창고 오두막을 고쳤듯 이 정류장들을 고쳐 주면.

en: <expr=happy>I'll give you bus rides for free!
<expr=confused>Heck, I don't think bears have any pockets for money anyway!
ko: <expr=confused>애초에 곰한테 돈 넣을 주머니가 있는지도 모르겠지만!

en: <expr=Neutral>Look, the first one is right there next to the Shed. How about it?
ko: <expr=Neutral>첫 정류장은 오두막 바로 옆에 있어. 어때?

en: <expr=Neutral>So how about it bud, you keen on fixing that bus stop?
Did you get that bus stop fixed?
<expr=happy>I can smell the gasoline burning through my nose hairs already!
<expr=Neutral>Listen, anytime you come across one of these stops, just give it a wash, slap a new sign on it.
ko: <expr=Neutral>이런 정류장을 만나면 씻어 주고 새 표지판만 달아.

en: <expr=happy>And boom! I'll drive you there anytime!
<expr=happy>Nice of you to drop by again.
<stance=Neutral><expr=mad>I'm looking for a way to be more entertaining, I think.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>더 재미있게 할 방법을 찾고 있는 것 같아요.

en: <expr=thinking>But if you ask me, there's nothing more fun than sitting in front of a screen for a few dozen hours.
ko: <expr=thinking>하지만 내 생각엔 화면 앞에 수십 시간 앉아 있는 것보다 재미있는 건 없지.

en: <expr=excited>And playing a good ol' video game.
<expr=Neutral>After a long day of driving people around in my bus there's nothing better than relaxing with a game.
ko: <expr=Neutral>온종일 버스로 사람들을 태우고 나면 게임으로 쉬는 게 최고야.

en: <expr=confused>Of course they had to stop making it, the technology couldn't quite keep up with real buses.
ko: <expr=confused>물론 더는 안 만들더라. 기술이 진짜 버스를 못 따라가거든.

en: <expr=Neutral>Say, if you wanted to be more entertaining, I could give you one of my games!
ko: <expr=Neutral>더 재미있어지고 싶다면 내 게임 하나를 줄 수 있어!

en: <expr=thinking>Well, I only have my originals, but if you found a disc to copy them.
<expr=Neutral>I could get you sorted! For a little price, if you wouldn't mind.
<expr=happy>A silver disc should be good enough for these ones, bud.
ko: <expr=happy>이 게임들은 은빛 디스크면 충분할 거야, 친구.

en: <expr=thinking>Last I remember there was a big bag found in the river in Pinefall.
<expr=Neutral>Maybe some washed up along the shore there.
<expr=Neutral>I'm gonna need a silver disc if you want any of my games bud.
ko: <expr=Neutral>내 게임이 필요하면 은빛 디스크가 있어야 해.

en: <expr=Neutral>So whaddya say bud, any luck finding a silver disc?
<expr=excited>Ah that's absolutely quality bud. Good on ya!
<expr=happy>Here bud, this is was my favourite game growing up.
ko: <expr=happy>여기, 이건 어릴 때 가장 좋아하던 게임이야.

en: <expr=thinking>You're gonna need a kickass machine to run it tho, can't give people those little handheld things can ya?
ko: <expr=thinking>돌리려면 멋진 기계가 필요할걸. 손님들에게 그 작은 휴대용 기기를 줄 순 없잖아?

en: <expr=Neutral>If you want more games, I'll set some up in my little shop in the back.
ko: <expr=Neutral>게임이 더 필요하면 뒤쪽 내 작은 상점에 마련해 둘게.

en: <expr=confused>It'll cost ya a bit, but ripping these discs ain't free for me either.
ko: <expr=confused>돈은 조금 들 거야. 디스크 복사가 나한테도 공짜는 아니거든.

en: <expr=Neutral>You better get back there and try these out bud!
<expr=Neutral>Go on then, get that game up and running!
<expr=Neutral>No luck on that golden disc yet huh, bud?
<expr=happy>Hey again bud! Business is a-boomin' I suppose!
<expr=Neutral>Alright bud! Got anything nice and golden for me?
ko: <expr=Neutral>좋아! 내게 줄 멋진 황금빛 물건이 있니?

en: <expr=Neutral>I trust the games where a great success, eh?
<expr=thinking>Well I was thinking, there's a whole bunch of newer games that have come out since I was a kid.
ko: <expr=thinking>내가 어릴 때 이후로 새 게임이 아주 많이 나왔잖아.

en: <expr=Neutral>What they lack in that sweet nostalgia, they make up for in the one thing players fear most.
ko: <expr=Neutral>달콤한 추억이 부족한 대신 게이머들이 가장 두려워하는 걸로 채웠지.

en: <expr=happy>But if you manage to find one of those new golden discs out there somewhere.
<expr=Neutral>I can get you some really fresh games!
ko: <expr=Neutral>아주 신선한 게임을 구해 줄 수 있어!

en: <expr=Neutral>Alrighty then, as promised here's my favourite one from recent times.

en: <expr=thinking>The person who made it really likes to make you think, ya know?

en: <expr=Neutral>Have fun there bud, and if you want any more, just check my little shop.

<stance=Hunched><expr=confused>I'm looking for Barbara. Have you seen her?

<expr=thinking>But I do have something a little bit more heavyweight.
<expr=Neutral>Give it here. Maybe the ol' jeweler's kit can cut through it.

Guests will now expect an even better Decoration rating, and they will offer more money.
ko: 이제 손님들은 더 나은 장식 평가를 기대하며 요금도 더 많이 냅니다.

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=sad>No sign of Barbara on the beach. No sign of her anywhere.
<expr=Neutral>Yeah, the little boat that's usually here is gone too.
<stance=Neutral><expr=blush>And there's a tiny postcard on the dock... what did you say?
<expr=Neutral>Cause who uses postcards anymore, am I right?
<expr=Neutral>Barbara's probably just running around somewhere, looking for increasingly suspicious things.
ko: <expr=Neutral>바버라는 그냥 어딘가 돌아다니며 점점 더 수상한 걸 찾고 있을 거야.

en: <expr=Neutral>Silly old bear, actually. Since when do inanimate objects hold two-way conversations?
ko: <expr=Neutral>사실은 엉뚱한 늙은 곰이지. 생물도 아닌 물건이 언제부터 서로 대화했어?

en: <stance=HandsUp><expr=ecstatic>Since always! I always talk to my favourite objects.
ko: <stance=HandsUp><expr=ecstatic>원래 그랬는데! 난 좋아하는 물건들한테 늘 말을 걸어.

en: <expr=Neutral>Yeah? How do you know I'm your favourite?
ko: <expr=Neutral>그래? 내가 마음에 드는 물건인지는 어떻게 알아?

en: <expr=Neutral>You haven't even flipped me over and read what I say yet.
<expr=Neutral>I'm in no rush. I've got the rest of your life.
ko: <expr=Neutral>난 안 급해. 네 남은 평생이 있으니까.

en: <expr=laughing>Being afraid of heights just means you haven't seen everything that's down there yet.
ko: <expr=laughing>높은 곳이 무섭다는 건 아래에 있는 걸 아직 다 못 봤다는 뜻이야.

en: <expr=Neutral>The woods are peaceful and quiet these days.
<expr=surprised>There's mushrooms out there they say can give you the worst nightmares.
<expr=laughing>I could sure go for some right now.

ko: <expr=laughing>우린 아직 만난 적 없는 것 같은데.

en: <expr=laughing>Good! Physical activity is always a great idea.
<expr=coy>I've been around these woods for a while. I think I get the gist of what you're saying.
ko: <expr=coy>이 숲에서 오래 지냈거든. 대충 무슨 말인지는 알겠어.

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>Oh yeah? Then what am I saying right now:
ko: <stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>그래요? 그럼 지금 뭐라고 하는지 맞혀 봐요.

en: <expr=thinking>That was pretty unintelligible. I guess I could use the practice.
ko: <expr=thinking>그건 꽤 알아듣기 어렵네. 연습이 더 필요하겠어.

en: <expr=Neutral>What's a big softie like you doing all the way here?
<stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>I'm looking for Beanie. I have something for her.
<expr=surprised>Oh. That's, uhh, just a nickname. I'm Beanie.
<expr=sad>But I like... um... Beanie. No one calls me that anymore.
ko: <expr=sad>하지만 난... 음... 비니가 좋아. 요즘은 아무도 안 불러 주거든.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>Oliver, the bus person. He gave me a letter for you!
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>버스 아저씨 올리버요. 편지를 전해 달라고 했어요!

en: <expr=Neutral>No wonder he trusted you, let me see it.
<expr=surprised>I can't believe he found it! Olly, you weasel! Where was it? Did he tell you?
ko: <expr=surprised>찾았다니 믿기지 않아! 올리, 이 족제비 같은 녀석! 어디 있었대? 말해 줬니?

en: <expr=laughing>No, no, he found the last page of our atlas!
ko: <expr=laughing>아니, 아니. 우리 지도책의 마지막 장을 찾았어!

en: <expr=Neutral>We made this ages ago! He had barely gotten his driver license and I had a much smaller hat.
ko: <expr=Neutral>아주 오래전에 만들었지! 올리는 막 면허를 땄고 내 모자는 훨씬 작았어.

en: <expr=Neutral>We mapped out the whole Valley, figured out where to put stations for his buses and everything.
ko: <expr=Neutral>계곡 전체를 지도로 그리고 버스 정류장을 어디 둘지까지 정했지.

en: <expr=sad>I thought this burned up in the fire.
<stance=HandsDown><expr=surprised>I didn't know the fire was that big.
<expr=thinking>Listen, I know you came all this way, but could you get this thing back to him?
ko: <expr=thinking>멀리 온 건 알지만 이걸 다시 전해 줄 수 있니?

en: <expr=sad>I bet he doesn't even know I have the rest!
ko: <expr=sad>나머지를 내가 가지고 있다는 건 모를 거야!

en: <expr=Neutral>Here, you can have this! It'll help you find your way back faster!
ko: <expr=Neutral>여기, 이건 네가 가져! 돌아가는 길을 더 빨리 찾게 해 줄 거야!

en: <expr=Neutral>I figured something must have gone down south.
<expr=annoyed>That damn Shark's got people coming in droves!
<expr=mad>I have to go keep an eye out on the dam near the lake.
ko: <expr=mad>난 호수 근처 댐을 살피러 가야 해.

en: <expr=laughing>So the barrier up to Highlake is open.
<expr=Neutral>If you make your way up there, look me up. I know the place inside and out.
ko: <expr=Neutral>그쪽으로 오면 날 찾아. 구석구석 알고 있으니까.

en: <expr=Neutral>Look who waddled their way up the windy road.
<stance=Neutral><expr=coy>I would call it more of a wobble.
<expr=Neutral>Now, I'm not going to insult your intelligence.
<expr=Neutral>But this used to be the prettiest place to spend a summer in.
ko: <expr=Neutral>하지만 여긴 한때 여름을 보내기 가장 예쁜 곳이었어.

en: <expr=laughing>The soft wave of the trees in the wind, the calmness of the water.
<expr=thinking>No wonder the Captain built his vacation house here.
<expr=Neutral>I remember it had the most amazing garden. You could see it from the dam.
ko: <expr=Neutral>정원이 정말 멋졌던 게 기억나. 댐에서도 보였어.

en: <expr=thinking>Obviously you weren't allowed anywhere near the place.
<expr=laughing>You should check it out, it's just up the dirt road.
ko: <expr=laughing>한번 가 봐. 흙길을 조금 올라가면 돼.

en: <expr=Neutral>I'm sure there's some fruit or something you can eat along the way.
ko: <expr=Neutral>가는 길에 먹을 과일 같은 것도 있을 거야.

en: <expr=thinking>That is your main occupation right? Eating fruit?
<stance=Neutral><expr=coy>I would never limit myself to just fruit.
<expr=laughing>I'm going over the dam to my outpost. I'll see you around.
ko: <expr=laughing>난 댐을 건너 초소로 갈게. 또 보자.

en: <expr=Neutral>You should look around the Farmhouse to the northeast.
<expr=laughing>Hey if it isn't the most charming bear this side of town.
<stance=Neutral><expr=coy>That's only cause I haven't been to the other side of town yet.
<expr=Neutral>I was just about to pack up, what can I do ya for?
<stance=Neutral><expr=angry>I'm on the lookout for some fresh food things.
<expr=thinking>Well, there's plenty of fruits and roots that grow around here.
<expr=surprised>OH! If you're looking for something a little more special.
<expr=laughing>There's used to be a greenhouse up north, near the old Winter Lodge.
ko: <expr=laughing>북쪽 옛 겨울 산장 근처에 온실이 있었어.

en: <expr=Neutral>I don't know if it's up to snuff anymore, but they kept some pretty peculiar seeds.
ko: <expr=Neutral>아직 쓸 만한지는 모르지만 꽤 특이한 씨앗을 보관했지.

en: <expr=Neutral>You follow the road north, past the Broadcast Station.
<expr=Neutral>And right up into Winterberry, I doubt the keepers would still be around.
ko: <expr=Neutral>윈터베리까지 곧장 올라가면 돼. 관리인은 이제 없을 것 같지만.

en: <expr=laughing>Ain't no harm in checking! I'll open up a path for ya.
ko: <expr=laughing>확인해서 손해 볼 건 없지! 길을 열어 줄게.

en: <expr=Neutral>But I'm waddling my own behind straight back to the tower after.
ko: <expr=Neutral>다만 난 그다음 곧장 감시탑으로 뒤뚱뒤뚱 돌아갈 거야.

en: <expr=coy>Oh aren't you just a big softie.
<expr=Neutral>Come back with a couple of servings of chilly mac.
<expr=laughing>Oh yeah, that's the stuff. Thanks a lot! I owe you one.
ko: <expr=laughing>아, 그래. 바로 이거야. 고마워! 신세를 졌네.

en: <expr=Neutral>Here's the photo of the old beast! It's a little blurry, but you can definitely see it's not human!
ko: <expr=Neutral>옛 야수의 사진이야! 좀 흐릿하지만 인간이 아닌 건 분명해!

en: <expr=Neutral>Hey there you big softie! Bet you haven't changed a bit!
<stance=Neutral><expr=angry>I'm looking for the mysteries of the forest. Know any?
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=angry>숲의 수수께끼를 찾고 있어요. 아는 거 있어요?

en: <expr=surprised>Oh boy OH BOY have I got something for you!
<expr=Neutral>So you spend most of your time in the forest right?
<expr=surprised>You ever come across something TWICE as large and THRICE as hairy as you?
ko: <expr=surprised>너보다 두 배 크고 털은 세 배 많은 걸 본 적 있니?

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>Well if I don't take care of myself for a while...
<expr=Neutral>So I was out one day a little bit further than I usually go, looking for my usual herbs.
ko: <expr=Neutral>어느 날 늘 찾던 허브를 구하러 평소보다 조금 멀리 갔거든.

en: <expr=annoyed>When out of nowhere this huge hulking creature jumps out in the field next to me.
ko: <expr=annoyed>갑자기 거대하고 육중한 생물이 옆 들판으로 뛰어나왔어.

en: <expr=laughing>Am I glad I had my camera! I managed to snap a few shots 'cause I knew no one would believe me otherwise.
ko: <expr=laughing>카메라가 있어서 얼마나 다행이었는지! 아니면 아무도 안 믿을 것 같아 몇 장 찍었지.

en: <expr=thinking>Oh. Well. You're definitely the first! And this is definitely mysterious!
ko: <expr=thinking>아. 그래. 네가 첫 번째네! 이건 확실히 신비로워!

en: <expr=coy>You can have it in exchange for a little grub.
<expr=laughing>I've seen what you feed those people out there, it ain't chump chow!
ko: <expr=laughing>손님들에게 주는 음식을 봤거든. 보통 밥이 아니던데!

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Oh you know, looking for berries, refurbishing old houses.
<expr=sad>Well, I ain't got much you could work on here.
<expr=thinking>Except maybe the old broadcast station up north.
<expr=Neutral>But no one's got any use for that anymore.
<stance=HandsDown><expr=happy>Actually, I had a thing I needed your help with.
<expr=laughing>Oh shoot! I ain't good at skimming plaster, but I can tell you which mushrooms will make you feel funny!
ko: <expr=laughing>말해 봐! 미장질은 못 해도 기분이 이상해지는 버섯은 알려 줄 수 있어!

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>Well, we're trying to give folks a more, uh, outdoorsy experience.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>손님들에게 좀 더 어, 야외 체험을 제공하려고요.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>And apparently rolling in grass until the ground smells like you isn't part of that.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>땅에 자기 냄새가 밸 때까지 풀밭을 구르는 건 아닌 모양이더라고요.

en: <expr=Neutral>Well, most people don't mind a little dirt on their butt or smoke in their face.
ko: <expr=Neutral>대부분 엉덩이에 흙이 좀 묻거나 얼굴에 연기가 닿는 건 괜찮아해.

en: <expr=thinking>Tell you what, if you clear out a bit of space for a camping spot.
<expr=Neutral>I can get you some basic things to get started.
<expr=Neutral>So how about it? You got a campground ready to go?
<expr=thinking>I'm almost done, I'm just missing a bit of fuel and I left my canister behind.
ko: <expr=thinking>거의 다 됐는데 연료가 조금 부족해. 연료통을 두고 왔거든.

en: <expr=laughing>Can you fetch me some while I finish up?
<expr=thinking>Alright good. Now, the key to a great camping spot.
<expr=surprised>Is to make it feel the greatest waiting room in the world.
ko: <expr=surprised>세상에서 가장 멋진 대기실처럼 느끼게 하는 거야.

en: <expr=Neutral>It should be relaxing and quiet, but just temporary enough.
<expr=Neutral>So that you don't overstay your welcome.
<expr=surprised>I mean, you don't have to worry about that.
<expr=Neutral>Pleasure is all mine big guy, how you doin'?
<expr=sad>You alright? You seem a little down.
<stance=Hunched><expr=scary>Have you seen the old lady in the green hat lately?
<expr=thinking>I actually saw her a few hours ago, roaming the Valley like she always does.
ko: <expr=thinking>몇 시간 전에 봤어. 평소처럼 계곡을 돌아다녔지.

en: <expr=laughing>I didn't pay no mind since she ignores me and I ignore her, it's how it's always been.
ko: <expr=laughing>서로 아는 척 안 하는 사이라 별생각 안 했어. 늘 그랬거든.

en: <expr=thinking>But she did seem in an awful hurry this time.
<expr=Neutral>Oh and she was missing her green hat.
<stance=HandsDown><expr=surprised>Was she alone? Was she being kidnapped? Do you know where she was going?
<expr=thinking>Definitely wasn't being kidnapped, unless you can kidnap yourself.
ko: <expr=thinking>자기 자신을 납치할 수 있는 게 아니라면 납치는 아니었어.

en: <expr=Neutral>She was headed down to the desert.
<expr=laughing>By my estimate, it looked like she was en route to hit the beach.
Tony's Construction Service. No available instructions.
ko: 토니의 건설 서비스. 현재 안내가 없습니다.

en: Is the structure clear of any debris or garbage?
ko: 건물 안의 잔해와 쓰레기를 모두 치웠나요?

en: Step 2: Gather construction materials needed to repair the structure.
ko: 2단계: 건물 수리에 필요한 건설 재료를 모으세요.

en: In this case: Iron Plates, Pinewood Planks, Mahogany Planks and Steel Screws.
ko: 필요한 재료: 철판, 소나무 판자, 마호가니 판자, 강철 나사.

en: Have all the materials been acquired?
Step 3: Get your butt to work!
Welcome to the Big Winter Cabin!
ko: 대형 겨울 산장에 오신 걸 환영합니다!

en: <expr=wild>The true Lord of Blood will descend upon us all!
<expr=excited>His dark and red mantle will envelop the world.
<expr=wild>His ardent claws will tear your soul from its fleshy prison.
ko: <expr=wild>불타는 발톱이 살의 감옥에서 네 영혼을 뜯어내리라.

en: <expr=blush>His blood red eyes... are so dreamy!
<expr=confused>A crimson moon will rise upon the world!
<expr=thinking>Where do you get off coming into the dark brood's lair?
<stance=Neutral><expr=coy>It didn't look that dark to me.
<expr=excited>Your flesh looks nice and tender, just like He likes it.
ko: <expr=excited>네 살이 부드러워 보이는구나. 그분이 좋아하는 식이지.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>We're by the sea, I count one, two, three weird-looking devils. Do you know anything about dark forces?
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>바닷가고, 이상하게 생긴 악마가 하나 둘 셋. 어둠의 힘에 대해 아는 거 있어?

en: <expr=thinking>Woah there guy. We know nothing on an empty stomach.
<expr=Neutral>Yeah, that's right. We want something nice and juicy for ourselves.
ko: <expr=Neutral>그래, 맞아. 우리도 맛있고 촉촉한 걸 먹고 싶어.

en: <expr=confused>IF we were to know anything, that is.
<stance=Neutral><expr=blush>Well, I've thought about it and... you can't have a bite of me.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>생각해 봤는데... 나를 한입 먹게 해 줄 수는 없어.

en: <expr=thinking>EW! What are you? A ding dong? That's disgusting!
<expr=Neutral>We could never go on His turf, but we could go for some nice peaches.
ko: <expr=Neutral>그분 영역을 침범할 순 없지. 대신 맛있는 복숭아는 좋겠군.

en: <expr=confused>Yeah! But not just any peaches. They better be nice and cooked and tender-like.
ko: <expr=confused>그래! 아무 복숭아나 말고. 잘 익혀서 부드러워야 해.

en: <expr=Neutral>And there better be enough for all of us.
<expr=Neutral>You ain't ever gonna be as good as peaches, so quit tryin'.
ko: <expr=Neutral>넌 절대 복숭아만큼 맛있지 않을 테니 노력 그만해.

en: I do! Got three peach cobblers for you.
ko: 응! 복숭아 코블러 세 개 가져왔어.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>I do! Got three peach cobblers for you.
<expr=Neutral>So what do you want to know? Has He come to you? Has He talked to you?
ko: <expr=Neutral>뭘 알고 싶지? 그분이 찾아왔어? 말을 걸었나?

en: <stance=HandsDown><expr=blush>I don't think so? I don't know. I've never heard of anyone like that.
ko: <stance=HandsDown><expr=blush>아닌 것 같은데? 모르겠어. 그런 얘긴 처음 들어.

en: <expr=excited>But you ARE looking for Him, correct?
<expr=Neutral>Otherwise what are you doing fetching peaches for a bunch of good-looking weirdos?
ko: <expr=Neutral>아니면 이 잘생긴 괴짜들에게 왜 복숭아를 가져오겠어?

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>Well, I've had some weird dreams lately.
<expr=excited>So He HAS paid you a visit.
<expr=wild>Before he HUNTS YOUR FLESH AND FEASTS ON YOUR REMAINS!
ko: <expr=wild>네 살을 사냥하고 시체로 만찬을 즐기기 전에!

en: <expr=confused>He terrorizes your dreams to tenderize your brain.
ko: <expr=confused>꿈에서 공포를 줘서 뇌를 부드럽게 하시는 거야.

en: <expr=excited>The fewer thoughts the better. Less chewy.
<stance=Hunched><expr=bored>I am both scared and also do not believe a word you're saying.
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=bored>무섭기도 한데 너희 말은 한마디도 못 믿겠어.

en: <expr=thinking>Oh no?! Well, don't come to us when you'll be just another bag of bones for His pile.
ko: <expr=thinking>그래?! 그분의 뼈 더미에 네 뼈가 쌓일 때 우리를 찾지 마!

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=confused>I don't think you thought that one through...
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=confused>그 말은 깊이 생각 안 한 것 같은데...

en: <expr=Neutral>Listen, if you're so sure He does not exist, we challenge you!
<expr=excited>Yes! We challenge you to PROVE that He does not exist!
ko: <expr=excited>그래! 그분이 존재하지 않는다는 걸 증명해 봐!

en: <expr=Neutral>Go to the forbidden forest, the Darkgrove. To the east you'll find an entrance to a cave.
ko: <expr=Neutral>금지된 숲 다크그로브로 가. 동쪽에 동굴 입구가 있을 거야.

en: <expr=confused>That's the last place we saw him. Or we think we did, he doesn't like to be seen.
ko: <expr=confused>우리가 마지막으로 뵌 곳이지. 봤다고 생각한 곳인가. 모습을 드러내기 싫어하시거든.

en: <expr=Neutral>Yes! Once there, find and bring us evidence that He does not exist.
<expr=excited>It's the only way to prove your theory, of course.
<expr=Neutral>Found anything? Bet you didn't even go!
I did, actually. I found this feather.
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>I did, actually. I found this feather.
<expr=wild>You HAVE found evidence. It's so clear now.
<expr=Neutral>Oh yes! He calls for you! You must seek Him!
ko: <expr=Neutral>아니, 있어! 그분이 널 부르신다! 찾아가야 해!

en: <expr=confused>You now know where you must go to find Him.
<expr=excited>The cave. The CAVE! How could we have been so blind?
ko: <expr=excited>동굴. 동굴이야! 우린 어쩌면 이렇게 눈이 멀었을까?

en: <expr=Neutral>On our last voyage there, we found this key on the ground.
ko: <expr=Neutral>지난번 갔을 때 바닥에서 이 열쇠를 찾았어.

en: <expr=blush>Well, we found the little fuzzy thing, the key came with it. It might be useful inside the cave.
ko: <expr=blush>정확히는 작고 복슬복슬한 걸 찾았는데 열쇠가 달려 있었지. 동굴 안에서 쓸모 있을 거야.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>And what if I refuse to go look for your Bird God?
<expr=wild>GO TO THE CAVE! FIND THE BIRD GOD!
<expr=confused>So? Was there anything in there? Did you see Him?
<stance=Hunched><expr=bored>I hate to break it to you fellas, there aren't any gods. Definitely not any bird ones.
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=bored>안됐지만 얘들아, 신은 없어. 새의 신은 더더욱.

en: <expr=excited>Ha! I told you he'd be too scared to go.
<stance=Neutral><expr=angry>I went through the entire cave. And I found your "Bird God".
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=angry>동굴 전체를 둘러봤어. 그리고 너희 "새의 신"도 찾았지.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>I did actually. His name is Vlad and he has a considerably smaller amount of teeth than what I was told.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>찾았다니까. 이름은 블라드고 들었던 것보다 이빨이 훨씬 적었어.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>Turns out parrots shed feathers. Especially when forced into a tiny room.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>앵무새도 털갈이를 한대. 특히 좁은 방에 갇혀 있으면.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=angry>Oh and he asked you don't go creeping on him anymore. He's got... other priorities.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=angry>아, 더는 몰래 훔쳐보지 말래. 다른... 중요한 일이 있거든.

en: <expr=Neutral>The vision in the dream said to look for it. Look for the Bird God.
ko: <expr=Neutral>꿈속 환영이 찾으라고 했어. 새의 신을 찾으라고.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>I'm starting to think we all should skip late dinners before bed.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>우리 모두 자기 전 늦은 식사는 거르는 게 좋겠어.

en: <expr=blush>Maybe it was just our imagination. I haven't dreamed it in a while.
ko: <expr=blush>그냥 상상이었을지도. 그 꿈도 한동안 안 꿨어.

en: <expr=Neutral>Yeah, me neither. Not since the night of the fire, after the bear died.
ko: <expr=Neutral>응, 나도. 불이 난 밤에 곰이 죽은 뒤로는.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>So that settles it, we- The what?
<expr=excited>Yeah, the big fire? Were you born yesterday?
<stance=HandsDown><expr=surprised>What was that about a bear? There's no other bears in the Valley except me and my mom.
ko: <stance=HandsDown><expr=surprised>곰 얘기는 뭐야? 계곡의 곰은 나랑 엄마뿐인데.

en: <expr=thinking>Yeah there was... they died in the fire we think.
ko: <expr=thinking>다른 곰도 있었어... 불에 죽은 것 같지만.

en: <expr=excited>How do you not know about that?
<expr=thinking>It was a big deal, that doesn't usually happen.
<stance=HandsUp><expr=surprised>Who was the bear? Did you know them? How did it happen?
<expr=Neutral>Look guy, you mind taking your unexpected revelations elsewhere?
ko: <expr=Neutral>네 갑작스러운 깨달음은 다른 데 가서 나누면 안 되겠어?

en: <expr=thinking>We kind of have our own to deal with here.
<expr=Neutral>Yeah, besides, it's not us you should be asking about bears around here.
ko: <expr=Neutral>그래. 애초에 이 동네 곰 얘기를 물어볼 상대는 우리가 아니지.

en: <expr=cry>Our flavor is murderous, ruthless gods. And those aren't even "in" anymore, apparently.
ko: <expr=cry>우리 취향은 살인적이고 무자비한 신들이야. 이제 유행도 아닌 모양이지만.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>Yeah, I'll find someone else to ask...
<expr=Neutral>Do we look 7-feet tall with fuzzy tails to you? We don't know anything about bears.
ko: <expr=Neutral>우리가 키 7피트에 복슬복슬한 꼬리가 있는 것처럼 보여? 곰 얘기는 몰라.

en: <expr=happy>It's just me, your local wood samaritan.
<expr=happy>Don't mind me, just living the wood life.
ko: <expr=happy>신경 쓰지 마. 나무랄 데 없는 삶을 사는 중이니.

en: <expr=Neutral>If a tree falls in the woods, does it make a sound?
<expr=happy>Yes it does, and I always recommend lumber support for serious injuries.
ko: <expr=happy>당연히 나지. 크게 다쳤다면 언제나 목재 받침을 추천해.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>It's just me sir. Hank, from the Thicket.
<expr=happy>I'm just yanking your tail, boy. How's your mother?
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>She's great. Listen, I wanted to ask if you could help us. We've got a..
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>잘 지내세요. 도와주실 수 있을까 해서요. 저희가...

en: <expr=blush>HELP? Why didn't you say so! What do you need? A stack of birch?
ko: <expr=blush>도움? 진작 말하지! 뭐가 필요하니? 자작나무 한 더미?

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>Well, actually, my friends and I were wondering...
<expr=surprised>An oak spoon? Oh, I think Margaret would love that!
<expr=happy>Has anyone taught you how to saw yet?
<stance=Neutral><expr=mad>No, there's this Shark in Timber Crossing.
<expr=blush>Oh, OH! A redwood plaque for your fish?
ko: <expr=blush>아, 아하! 그 물고기한테 줄 삼나무 명패가 필요하구나?

en: <stance=HandsUp><expr=ecstatic>He says he's bringing Humans to the Valley!
<expr=scared>We haven't seen those in a while, have we?
<expr=Neutral>What could I possibly have to do with that?
<stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>How much do you know about building things?
<expr=happy>Well, as you of course know, everything People make is perfect.
ko: <expr=happy>너도 물론 알겠지만, 인간이 만드는 건 뭐든 완벽하단다.

en: <expr=thinking>When I took over the Mill here I found all these papers and schematics. It felt like stumbling upon artifacts.
ko: <expr=thinking>이 제재소를 맡았을 때 서류랑 설계도가 잔뜩 나왔거든. 유물을 발견한 기분이었지.

en: <expr=happy>Never thought wood could take so many shapes. Look here.
ko: <expr=happy>나무로 이렇게 다양한 모양을 만들 수 있을 줄은 몰랐어. 여기 보렴.

en: <expr=surprised>Clearly only an incredible being could come up with all of this.
ko: <expr=surprised>이런 걸 생각해 내다니, 분명 대단한 존재들일 거야.

en: <expr=Neutral>Oh, anyone can! It's quite simple once you figure out how to read these things.
ko: <expr=Neutral>누구든 만들 수 있지! 이걸 읽는 법만 알면 꽤 간단하단다.

en: <expr=blush>Would you like me to teach you?
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Yes! Well, I was hoping you could help us fix up this old shack in Timber Crossing.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>네! 사실 팀버 크로싱에 있는 낡은 오두막 수리를 도와주셨으면 해서요.

en: <expr=blush>How wonderful! We'll need my back saw and mallet, a ladder, OH! And a couple of stacks of pine!
ko: <expr=blush>아주 좋구나! 등대기톱이랑 망치, 사다리, 아! 소나무 목재도 두어 더미 필요하겠어!

en: <expr=Neutral>Fetch those for me, will you? The bright yellow ones!
<expr=Neutral>Come back when you've fetched that lumber, will you?
<expr=Neutral>So, did you find all the wood?
<expr=happy>Grand! Perfect! You're doing such a great job!
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Uh, thanks, I just picked it off the ground.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>어, 고마워요. 그냥 땅에 떨어진 걸 주웠는데요.

en: <expr=happy>Now, I'm headed to Timber Crossing. I'll see you there!
ko: <expr=happy>그럼 난 팀버 크로싱으로 가마. 거기서 보자꾸나!

en: <expr=excited>...And we're gonna use this old shed.
<expr=happy>Haven't seen a Human claim it in years.
ko: <expr=happy>몇 년째 자기 거라고 나서는 인간도 없었거든요.

en: <expr=bored>Look who decided to finally show up!
<expr=Neutral>As I was telling your friend here, the wood you brought ought to be enough!
ko: <expr=Neutral>여기 네 친구한테도 말했지만, 가져온 목재면 충분하겠구나!

en: <expr=Neutral>I'll get started on this, first you'll have to clean up the shed of all the garbage.
ko: <expr=Neutral>난 작업을 시작하마. 우선 오두막 안의 쓰레기부터 치워 주렴.

en: <expr=Neutral>Just hit the wood against each other till something materializes. It's worked for me so far!
ko: <expr=Neutral>뭔가 만들어질 때까지 나무끼리 두드려 보렴. 난 여태 그 방법으로 잘해 왔단다!

en: <expr=Neutral>Now, Humans got over the cold stone floors and itchy hay a while ago.
ko: <expr=Neutral>인간들은 차가운 돌바닥이나 따가운 건초에서 자는 걸 진작 졸업했거든.

en: <expr=sad>They would much rather sleep on a clean, soft, springy surface.
ko: <expr=sad>깨끗하고 푹신하고 탄력 있는 데서 자는 걸 훨씬 좋아해.

en: <expr=thinking>Here. This is none of those things, but it'll do.
ko: <expr=thinking>자. 이건 그 어느 쪽도 아니지만, 일단 쓸 만할 거야.

en: <expr=Neutral>You can make a bed using the workbench. Come back when you've got one.
ko: <expr=Neutral>작업대에서 침대를 만들 수 있단다. 하나 만들면 다시 오렴.

en: <expr=Neutral>Were you able to make that bed?
<expr=surprised>I didn't think it could look worse than the schematics.
ko: <expr=surprised>설계도보다 못생기게 만들 수 있을 줄은 몰랐는데.

en: <expr=blush>OH. I mean, excellent! You're doing so well!
<expr=happy>Well, hurry along and put it to good use!
<expr=happy>Make a bedroom and put the bed in it.
<expr=Neutral>Come back after you've built a functional bedroom.
ko: <expr=Neutral>제대로 쓸 수 있는 침실을 만들면 다시 오렴.

en: <expr=Neutral>So, were you able to make that bedroom?
<expr=happy>Brilliant! I almost prefer it to the dead tree I used to sleep in.
ko: <expr=happy>훌륭해! 내가 자던 죽은 나무보다 나을지도 모르겠구나.

en: <expr=angry>Alright now, this is the most important step..
<expr=Neutral>Humans always need to feed their false sense of superiority.
ko: <expr=Neutral>인간은 자기들이 우월하다는 착각을 늘 채워 줘야 하거든.

en: <expr=grumpy>By having someone around that they can look down on.
<stance=Neutral><expr=coy>You sure seem to know a lot about that.
<expr=grumpy>So we're gonna need to make them feel welcome.
ko: <expr=grumpy>그러니까 환영받는 기분이 들게 해 줘야 해.

en: <expr=happy>By putting down a little table at the front of the house, that tells 'em where to go.
ko: <expr=happy>집 앞쪽에 작은 탁자를 놓고 어디로 가야 하는지 알려 주는 거지.

en: <expr=excited>And a little black book, to keep the records for the shark.
<expr=Neutral>Ah yes, here's how you make it. Quite straightforward really.
ko: <expr=Neutral>아, 그래. 만드는 법은 여기 있단다. 아주 간단하지.

en: <expr=Neutral>Just like the bed, but this time make a front desk. Over at the workbench you go!
ko: <expr=Neutral>침대를 만들 때처럼 하면 돼. 이번엔 접수대란다. 작업대로 가 보렴!

en: <expr=Neutral>So, did the Front Desk give you too much trouble?
ko: <expr=Neutral>그래, 접수대 만드는 건 많이 어렵진 않았니?

en: <expr=surprised>Oh, that's actually decent. You're starting to get good at this!
<expr=excited>Alright, alright, now go put it in there and then it's time to roll in the dough.
ko: <expr=excited>좋아, 좋아. 이제 안에 놓기만 하면 돈을 쓸어 담을 시간이야.

en: <expr=Neutral>Make sure you place the Front Desk inside the Shed.
<expr=happy>If I didn't know any better, I'd say you're a natural, Hank.
<stance=HandsDown><expr=blush>It's not that great, it took me forever and there's barely anything in there. Are they even gonna like it?
ko: <stance=HandsDown><expr=blush>그렇게 대단하진 않은데요. 엄청 오래 걸렸는데 안에 든 것도 별로 없잖아요. 인간들이 좋아하긴 할까요?

en: <expr=bored>You sure know how to take a compliment.
<stance=Neutral><expr=blush>Oh, uh, sorry. Thank you? Thank you!
<expr=excited>Go talk to Sharky-Boy! Tell him we got his joint ready.
ko: <expr=excited>상어 녀석한테 가 봐! 자기 가게 준비됐다고 전해.

en: <expr=thinking>Now, we'll have to use this old workbench.
<expr=Neutral>Well you can't hammer a nail in thin air! You need someplace to make it work.
ko: <expr=Neutral>허공에다 못을 박을 수는 없잖니! 작업할 자리가 필요하지.

en: <expr=thinking>The table next to the tree, Hank.
<expr=happy>Grab some wood and put it back together while I tidy up the place.
ko: <expr=happy>내가 여길 정리하는 동안 목재를 가져다가 다시 조립해 주렴.

en: <expr=excited>After you've made it, just put it down in the Shed and then it's time to rake in the dough.
ko: <expr=excited>만들었으면 오두막 안에 놓아. 그럼 돈을 긁어모을 시간이야.

en: <expr=happy>You have plenty of time to get better!
<expr=bored>Don't worry, he's been calling me that all day.
<stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>Look, I have it on very good authority that the Kiosk up there is our next best shot at getting more Humans to come.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>있잖아. 아주 믿을 만한 소식통에 따르면, 인간을 더 데려오려면 저 위의 안내소를 고치는 게 제일 좋대.

en: <expr=blush>Oh marvelous! The old Travel Kiosk was the jewel of Timber Crossing!
ko: <expr=blush>아, 멋지구나! 옛 관광 안내소는 팀버 크로싱의 보석이었지!

en: <expr=happy>It was one of the first things Humans built here.
ko: <expr=happy>인간이 여기에 처음 세운 건물 중 하나란다.

en: <expr=thinking>No, you'll actually find it's more of a rectangular parallelepiped.
<stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>So I think we should spruce it up like we did with the Shed.
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>And that'll attract more Humans and get us even more money, right, Will?
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>그럼 인간도 더 오고 돈도 더 벌 수 있겠지, 윌?

en: <expr=grumpy>I still want to know how you came up with that.
<expr=blush>Oh it's a BRILLIANT idea, as usual my son. STUDENT. Yes, that's what I said.
ko: <expr=blush>늘 그렇듯 아주 훌륭한 생각이구나, 내 아들아. 제자야. 그래, 그렇게 말했단다.

en: <expr=bored>I take it back, you don't actually get used to it.
<expr=Neutral>Well, let's get started right away. Go in there and clear the place out of all the rubble, then we'll get to building!
ko: <expr=Neutral>자, 바로 시작하자꾸나. 안에 들어가서 잔해를 전부 치워 주렴. 그다음 공사를 시작하자!

en: <expr=Neutral>Just clear out the Kiosk of any debris lying around inside and let me know when you're done.
ko: <expr=Neutral>안내소 안에 널린 잔해를 치우고, 다 끝나면 알려 주렴.

en: <expr=thinking>Now, if I remember everything correctly, there are a few things the Humans looked for in the Kiosk.
ko: <expr=thinking>내 기억이 맞는다면, 인간들은 안내소에 몇 가지 물건이 있길 바랐단다.

en: <expr=thinking>I can make a couple, but I don't have everything I need to get them just right.
ko: <expr=thinking>몇 개는 내가 만들 수 있지만, 제대로 갖추려면 재료가 조금 부족하구나.

en: <expr=Neutral>There's a few oddities I'd need to get it all together.
<expr=Neutral>I'll need a bit of Human literature.
<expr=excited>I've got a book back home we could use.
<expr=thinking>There's also an old computer sitting under the tower in Sawdust.
<expr=surprised>Oh, and some sort of writing apparatus.
<expr=thinking>I think the bus driver might have one in his little bus shack.
ko: <expr=thinking>버스 기사분의 작은 버스 오두막에 하나 있을 거야.

en: <expr=happy>Take your time, I'll put together everything else in the meantime.
<expr=Neutral>Still on that scavenger hunt? Just come back when you've gathered everything!
ko: <expr=Neutral>아직 물건을 찾고 있니? 다 모으면 다시 오렴!

en: It took a while, but here you go.
<expr=Neutral>I've done about all I can for this place.
ko: <expr=Neutral>여기서 내가 할 수 있는 일은 다 했구나.

en: <expr=happy>I think you've got a good start here.
<expr=thinking>Although there's quite a bit of work ahead of you still.
ko: <expr=thinking>물론 앞으로 할 일은 아직 많지만 말이야.

en: <expr=Neutral>I'll be back in my mill, if you ever need me.
ko: <expr=Neutral>난 제재소에 돌아가 있으마. 필요하면 언제든 오렴.

en: <expr=blush>Oh and, say hello to your mother for me.
<stance=Neutral><expr=happy>I'll tell her to drop by sometime.
<expr=happy>I can't wait to get my special little carving.
<expr=happy>So, may I have my gift now?
<expr=surprised>Oh this is WONDERFUL. I've never received such a thoughtful gift.
ko: <expr=surprised>아, 정말 멋지구나. 이렇게 정성 어린 선물은 처음 받아 봐.

en: <expr=blush>My boy, this is something any father would be ecstatic to receive.
ko: <expr=blush>얘야, 이런 걸 받으면 어떤 아버지라도 기뻐서 어쩔 줄 모를 거야.

en: <expr=scared>From uhh, anyone, including members outside of their immediate family. Yes.
ko: <expr=scared>어, 물론 누구에게 받든 말이다. 직계 가족이 아닌 누군가한테 받아도. 그래.

en: <expr=happy>But this is quite lovely, thank you.
<expr=Neutral>I would like to give you something in return that I have been saving for a long time.
ko: <expr=Neutral>답례로 오랫동안 간직해 온 걸 주고 싶구나.

en: <expr=thinking>I was holding this for someone else, but well, I think you should have it.
ko: <expr=thinking>원래는 다른 누군가에게 주려고 뒀지만, 네가 가져야 할 것 같아.

en: <expr=Neutral>This is my collection of ball bearings that I've gathered over the years.
<expr=happy>You can never have too many ball bearings!
<expr=sad>You never know when something needs to run a little more smoothly in your life.
ko: <expr=sad>살다 보면 언제 뭐가 좀 더 매끄럽게 돌아가야 할지 모르잖니.

en: <expr=happy>Yes, well, run along now, you little rascal.
<expr=Neutral>Oh hello my boy, pleasure seeing you again.
<stance=Neutral><expr=coy>Yeah! Never thought wood could be turned into so many things.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=coy>네! 나무로 그렇게 많은 걸 만들 수 있을 줄은 몰랐어요.

en: <expr=surprised>Oh yes, you could carve it into something useful like a chair.
ko: <expr=surprised>그렇지. 의자처럼 쓸모 있는 걸 깎아 만들 수도 있고.

en: <expr=thinking>Or turn it into a weapon. Like hmm...
<expr=happy>Yes, it's a fine replacement for just about anything.
ko: <expr=happy>그래, 웬만한 건 다 대신할 수 있지.

en: <expr=sad>Except maybe a child of your own.
<stance=Neutral><expr=mad>Err, say. I was working on a cabin and I had some extra wood laying around so I made you something.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=mad>어, 저기요. 오두막에서 작업하다 목재가 좀 남아서 선물을 만들었어요.

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=confused>Yeah, I made you a uhh... little carving! Of me!
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=confused>네, 어... 작은 조각품을 만들었어요! 제 모습으로요!

en: <expr=blush>Oh my! That's wonderful! If I had a refrigerator it would go right at the very top!
ko: <expr=blush>아이고! 정말 멋지구나! 냉장고가 있었다면 맨 위에 올려놓았을 텐데!

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>Yes. Yes! I left it back at the uhh... cabin. I'll be right back.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=thinking>네. 그럼요! 어... 오두막에 두고 왔어요. 금방 다녀올게요.

en: <expr=Neutral>You hang out with trash, you start to smell like garbage.
<expr=Neutral>People don't see the value in what they throw away until you point it out to them.
ko: <expr=Neutral>인간은 자기가 버린 물건의 가치를 누가 짚어 줘야 알아.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=angry>I live here, where did you come from?
<stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>I'm looking for something Humans like. Something that would make them feel more... distinguished.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>인간이 좋아하는 걸 찾고 있어. 좀 더... 품격 있는 기분이 들게 하는 거.

en: <expr=Neutral>That's where you're wrong, my colossal companion! I got what you need!
ko: <expr=Neutral>그게 바로 네 착각이지, 거대한 친구! 필요한 건 다 있거든!

en: <expr=smirk>You've stumbled upon the most handsome curator of crap this side of the Valley.
ko: <expr=smirk>이 계곡에서 제일 잘생긴 쓰레기 수집가를 만난 거야.

en: <expr=Neutral>There isn't one thing these animals throw away that I can't flip back at 'em!
ko: <expr=Neutral>저 짐승들이 버린 물건 중에 내가 되팔지 못할 건 없어!

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>Great! Let me just have a look in that dumpster.
<expr=confused>Not so fast, bozo. How do I know I can trust you?
ko: <expr=confused>어딜 그렇게 서둘러, 멍청아. 널 뭘 믿고?

en: <expr=Neutral>Be that as it may, we don't trade with just anyone off the street. My head would be in a gutter before noon!
ko: <expr=Neutral>그건 그렇다 쳐도 아무하고나 거래하진 않아. 그랬다간 점심 전에 내 머리가 시궁창에 처박힐걸!

en: <expr=blush>Although, I do spend a lot of time down there...
ko: <expr=blush>뭐, 거기서 보내는 시간도 꽤 많긴 하지만...

en: <expr=Neutral>You gotta be approved before I can sell you anything.
<expr=Neutral>I'll tell you what, there's a bus depot across the road.
ko: <expr=Neutral>이렇게 하자. 길 건너에 버스 정류장이 있거든.

en: <expr=wild>I can smell the stinky tuna from here.
<expr=ecstatic>Find me a snack, then we can talk.
ko: <expr=ecstatic>먹을 걸 찾아 와. 그럼 얘기해 보자고.

en: <expr=Neutral>I don't smell anything on you but you, and it ain't making me hungry.
ko: <expr=Neutral>네 몸에서 네 냄새밖에 안 나는데, 별로 입맛이 돌진 않네.
<expr=confused>묵은 빵에 딱딱한 치즈, 일주일 된 머스터드?

en: <expr=ecstatic>Mmm... just like mom used to make!
<expr=Neutral>I'll let you buy my special selection of swill.
ko: <expr=Neutral>내 특별한 구정물 컬렉션을 살 수 있게 해 주지.

en: <expr=Neutral>And here, I'll even let you have this one for free.
<expr=wild>But anything else comes at a price.
<expr=smirk>And I don't mean none of that stinking Human stuff.
ko: <expr=smirk>그 냄새나는 인간 물건 따위를 말하는 게 아냐.

en: <expr=confused>So how come I ain't seen you around here before?
ko: <expr=confused>근데 넌 왜 전엔 여기서 못 봤지?

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>Oh, we used to come here all the time, dumpster diving.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>아, 우리 전에도 쓰레기통 뒤지러 자주 왔어.

en: <expr=smirk>Oh really? Didn't take you for a criminal.
<stance=HandsDown><expr=blush>NO, no! It's not like that! My buddy Will always made me go.
ko: <stance=HandsDown><expr=blush>아냐, 아니야! 그런 게 아니라! 친구 윌이 자꾸 가자고 해서.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>And it was only magazines and pamphlets, no bad stuff.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=blush>잡지랑 안내 책자만 가져갔어. 나쁜 건 없었다고.

en: <expr=Neutral>Relax, my delinquent friend, I'm not gonna snitch if you ain't.
ko: <expr=Neutral>진정해, 비행 청소년 친구. 네가 입 다물면 나도 안 일러바쳐.

en: <expr=sad>Besides, haven't seen a lick of new Humans around here for a while.
ko: <expr=sad>그나저나 이 근처에 새 인간이 안 온 지도 꽤 됐네.

en: <expr=confused>Not since the couple that ran around after the big inferno.
ko: <expr=confused>그 큰불이 난 뒤로 돌아다니던 부부가 마지막이었지.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>Yeah, we used to never be allowed past the fence in the Thicket.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>맞아. 예전엔 덤불숲 울타리 밖으로 나가지도 못했어.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>Now we walk around like we own the place.
<expr=smirk>Never let anyone tell you that you don't.
ko: <expr=smirk>누가 뭐라 해도 여기가 네 땅이라고 생각해.

en: <expr=surprised>Anyways, Humans coming back in droves, huh?
<expr=Neutral>That's pretty wild if you pull it off.
<expr=smirk>And probably make a few folk pissy in the process.
<expr=Neutral>Listen, I get plenty of demand, so my business revolves around supply.
ko: <expr=Neutral>있잖아. 수요는 차고 넘치니까 내 장사는 공급에 달렸어.

en: <expr=Neutral>No Humans, no garbage to sell back to 'em.
<expr=Neutral>And especially slim pickings if we don't get any of the rich-looking kind.
ko: <expr=Neutral>특히 부자처럼 생긴 인간들이 안 오면 건질 게 별로 없지.

en: <expr=Neutral>I'll tell you what. Since you're fixing up the old Shed for 'em, how about you do the same for the Kiosk up here.
ko: <expr=Neutral>이렇게 하자. 인간들 쓰라고 낡은 오두막도 고치는 김에, 저 위의 안내소도 고쳐 보는 건 어때?

en: <expr=Neutral>They used to flock around that place like raccoons to a burger wrapper.
ko: <expr=Neutral>예전엔 너구리가 햄버거 포장지에 몰리듯 거기에 모여들었거든.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>I'm just getting the hang of it. This sounds a lot more complicated.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=Neutral>이제 막 감 잡는 중인데. 그건 훨씬 복잡할 것 같아.

en: <expr=smirk>Naaaaaah! This is a one and done deal. They just need a couple of things to keep them distracted.
ko: <expr=smirk>아니라니까! 한 번만 해 놓으면 끝이야. 인간들 정신 팔 물건 몇 개만 있으면 돼.

en: <expr=Neutral>The beaver will know all about it, he was here when the place was built!
ko: <expr=Neutral>비버가 잘 알 거야. 그걸 지을 때도 여기 있었으니까!

en: <expr=Neutral>Who knows what new kinds of goods we'll have in the shop.
ko: <expr=Neutral>가게에 어떤 새로운 물건들이 들어올지 누가 알겠어.

en: <expr=smirk>Yeah, it was 38 Across in the 1982 crossword semis. I found in the dumpster the other day.
ko: <expr=smirk>그래, 1982년 십자말풀이 준결승 가로 38번 정답이었어. 며칠 전에 쓰레기통에서 찾았지.

en: <expr=Neutral>No, you're thinking of the other thing.
<expr=ecstatic>There'll be more stuff for you to buy at the dumpster now.
ko: <expr=ecstatic>이제 쓰레기통에서 살 수 있는 물건이 더 늘어날 거야.

en: <expr=smirk>I'm putting in a good word with the big cheese.
<expr=Neutral>Come back when you have my coins kid.
<expr=smirk>Appreciate it kid, you did me a solid.
<expr=Neutral>Alright so, I've got something you wouldn't believe in a million years.
ko: <expr=Neutral>좋아. 네가 꿈에도 생각 못 할 물건이 하나 있거든.

en: <expr=surprised>Something inside this old busted bag worth a hundred times as much as you just handed over.
ko: <expr=surprised>이 낡고 망가진 가방 안에 방금 네가 준 돈의 백 배나 되는 보물이 들어 있어.

en: <expr=ecstatic>But that's the beauty of it. It could be anything!
ko: <expr=ecstatic>하지만 그게 묘미지. 뭐든 들어 있을 수 있잖아!

en: <expr=wild>No one knows what it is cause no one can get inside. It's a mystery box!
ko: <expr=wild>아무도 열지 못하니까 안에 뭐가 들었는지 아무도 몰라. 수수께끼 상자라고!

en: <expr=smirk>Yeah, it could be anything really! No one can prove you otherwise until they open it so...
ko: <expr=smirk>맞아, 정말 뭐든 있을 수 있지! 열기 전까진 아무도 아니라고 증명 못 하니까...

en: <expr=wild>Now scram, I've got money to count.
<expr=confused>I was wondering why it got darker all of a sudden.
<expr=Neutral>Haven't seen you around for a while. How you been kid?
<expr=Neutral>Listen, all this garbage you've been sending my way is great and all.
ko: <expr=Neutral>있잖아. 네 덕에 쓰레기가 많이 들어오는 건 좋은데.

en: <expr=confused>But I've gotten myself in a bit of a pickle.
<expr=smirk>A few thousand times more tactful actually.
<expr=ecstatic>But you know me! You help me out, I help you out!
ko: <expr=ecstatic>하지만 나 알잖아! 네가 날 도우면 나도 널 돕지!

en: <expr=blush>How about you chip in and I'll make it worth your while, yeah?
ko: <expr=blush>네가 좀 보태 주면 나도 섭섭지 않게 해 줄게. 어때?

en: <expr=Neutral>I saw a festering blob of rot the other day.
<expr=Neutral>Of course she's not a real witch!
<expr=happy>Almost fell into the cauldron once, but she saved me at the last second.
ko: <expr=happy>한번은 가마솥에 빠질 뻔했는데 마지막 순간에 구해 주셨어요.

en: <expr=thinking>Although I'm pretty sure she secretly wanted to see what would happen.
ko: <expr=thinking>사실 속으론 무슨 일이 벌어질지 보고 싶으셨던 것 같지만요.

en: <expr=happy>Let me know if you find a game for me. I used to love playing "Day In The Fields".
ko: <expr=happy>게임 찾으면 알려 주세요. 전 예전에 '들판에서의 하루'를 정말 좋아했어요.

en: <expr=confused>Ok, ok. This is the most perplexing object in all of existence, according to Ms. Charlotte at least!
ko: <expr=confused>좋아요, 좋아요. 적어도 샬럿 님 말로는 이게 세상에서 가장 불가사의한 물건이래요!

en: <expr=Neutral>No one can explain how it works or why, it just does!
ko: <expr=Neutral>왜, 어떻게 작동하는지 아무도 설명 못 해요. 그냥 작동해요!

en: <expr=happy>Howdy mister! Fancy seeing you 'round here again!
<expr=Neutral>It was sure sweet of ya to help out Wade. I hope he's doing alright.
ko: <expr=Neutral>웨이드를 도와주시다니 정말 친절하세요. 잘 지내고 있으면 좋겠어요.

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=bored>I'm sure he's found his way to uhh... safety!
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=bored>분명 어... 안전한 곳으로 잘 갔을 거야!

en: <expr=blush>Yeah, well it was sure nice to have a friend again.
ko: <expr=blush>네, 그래도 친구가 다시 생겨서 정말 좋았어요.

en: <expr=sad>We don't get many of those around here.
<expr=thinking>Only if you make 'em yourself while digging through the mud.
<expr=confused>But those don't say anything and I get bored pretty quick.
ko: <expr=confused>하지만 그렇게 만든 친구는 말을 안 해서 금방 지루해져요.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>I never get bored. It doesn't take much to entertain myself.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=happy>난 지루한 적이 없어. 별거 없어도 잘 놀거든.

en: <expr=happy>Me neither! I used to visit the old arcade near the Lighthouse before.
ko: <expr=happy>저도요! 예전엔 등대 근처의 오래된 오락실에 가곤 했어요.

en: <expr=ecstatic>They had the coolest games! That was never boring!
ko: <expr=ecstatic>정말 멋진 게임들이 있었죠! 절대 지루하지 않았어요!

en: <expr=blush>Hey listen! You get to go wherever you want! Do you think you could find me a cool video game?
ko: <expr=blush>있잖아요! 아저씨는 어디든 갈 수 있잖아요! 멋진 비디오 게임을 찾아 주실 수 있어요?

en: <expr=happy>I'll give you the best thing I ever dug out from the mud!
ko: <expr=happy>그럼 제가 진흙 속에서 찾아낸 것 중 제일 좋은 걸 드릴게요!

en: <expr=confused>It's so mysterious, no one knows how it works! Not even Ms. Charlotte!
ko: <expr=confused>얼마나 신비로운지 아무도 작동 원리를 몰라요! 샬럿 님도요!

en: <expr=annoyed>I'll have you know, I have absolutely no interest in the taste of blood.
ko: <expr=annoyed>분명히 말해 두건대, 짐은 피 맛 따위엔 전혀 관심 없느니라.

en: <expr=mad>Although that could change real quick if you keep staring.
ko: <expr=mad>계속 그렇게 쳐다보면 생각이 금방 바뀔 수도 있지만.

en: <expr=angry>I was called here by Humans who wish to pay me tribute!
<expr=cry>I guess they, just forgot about me...
<expr=laughing>Alright alright, the rumours are true, I am a bloodthirsty monster.
ko: <expr=laughing>알겠다, 알겠어. 소문이 맞느니라. 짐은 피에 굶주린 괴물이니라.

en: <expr=scared>Right now I'm also a winethirsty one, do you have some?
<expr=grumpy>Why haven't you brought my beets yet?
<expr=laughing>Oh finally, something to appease the royal stomach.
ko: <expr=laughing>오, 드디어 왕실의 위장을 달랠 것이 왔구나.

en: <expr=surprised>What's taken you so long anyway? I've been waiting here for what felt like ages.
ko: <expr=surprised>그나저나 어찌 그리 오래 걸렸느냐? 영겁을 기다린 것 같구나.

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=confused>What? No. I don't even know who you are.
<expr=annoyed>Peasants. They keep me waiting all this time and they finally send over peasants.
ko: <expr=annoyed>천민이라니. 짐을 이토록 기다리게 해 놓고 고작 천민을 보내다니.

en: <expr=grumpy>Listen, you, and listen well. Your king shall not be treated this way!
ko: <expr=grumpy>잘 듣거라. 너희 왕을 이런 식으로 대우해서는 안 되느니라!

en: <expr=annoyed>King, god, whatever you see me as.
ko: <expr=annoyed>왕이든 신이든, 네가 짐을 어떻게 여기든 말이다.

en: <expr=scared>I was quite happy in my old land, even without my special title!
ko: <expr=scared>짐은 원래 살던 땅에서도 아주 행복했느니라. 특별한 칭호 같은 게 없어도 말이지!

en: <expr=Neutral>I could even say that the modest amenities there were better than these... royal chambers.
ko: <expr=Neutral>거기의 소박한 시설이 이... 왕실보다 나았다고 해도 되겠구나.

en: <stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>I think we have very different definitions of royal, mister.
ko: <stance=Neutral><expr=smirk>왕실이란 말의 뜻을 너랑 나는 아주 다르게 아는 것 같은데.

en: <expr=annoyed>I can't believe they sent such a simpleton after all this time.
ko: <expr=annoyed>그토록 기다리게 하더니 이런 얼간이를 보내다니 믿을 수가 없구나.

en: <stance=HandsUp><expr=ecstatic>I'm sorry but, I don't think there's anything kingly about this place. It's a hole in the ground. An abandoned one.
ko: <stance=HandsUp><expr=ecstatic>미안하지만 여긴 왕실이랑 거리가 먼 것 같아. 땅에 난 구멍이잖아. 버려진 구멍.

en: <expr=mad>You wouldn't know noble blood if it executed you in the town square!
ko: <expr=mad>고귀한 혈통이 널 마을 광장에서 처형해도 넌 알아보지 못하겠구나!

en: <stance=Hunched><expr=annoyed>Why have you been locked in the... um... royal chambers for all this time?
ko: <stance=Hunched><expr=annoyed>그런데 왜 이렇게 오래... 어... 왕실에 갇혀 있었어?
